title: Testing Instrument Exogeneity with Copulas: Applications to Pricing, Education, and Peer Effects
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: Testing Instrument Exogeneity with Copulas: Applications to Pricing, Education, and Peer Effects

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article introduces a copula-based method to test the exogeneity of instrumental variables (IVs) in linear models, addressing a central weakness of IV designs. The authors establish a new correlation result: an instrument is exogenous if and only if its standard normal-score transformation is exogenous, for both continuous and discrete instruments. Building on this insight, the article develops an intuitive Wald test for the exogeneity of instrumental variables that augments the outcome regression with normal-score transformations and evaluates simple linear restrictions. Monte Carlo simulations that vary sample size, copula family, and error distributions show robust performance. The joint version of the test, which evaluates all instruments simultaneously, exhibits consistently low Type II error rates, even under heavy tails, asymmetry, or bimodality. Type I error is well controlled under Gaussian dependence and can be inflated under asymmetric dependence. The intended interpretation is conservative: non-rejection provides strong evidence of instrument validity, while rejection should be taken as a warning signal rather than definitive proof of invalidity. Applications to retail pricing, returns to education, and peer-based instruments in disclosure research illustrate how the test helps discriminate among candidate instruments and supports more credible causal claims in economics, marketing, and related fields.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于copula的方法来检验线性模型中工具变量的外生性，解决了IV设计的一个核心弱点。该方法通过标准正态分数变换建立了新的相关性结果，并开发了直观的Wald检验。模拟显示该方法在多种条件下表现稳健，应用案例展示了其在经济学、营销学等领域帮助筛选工具变量和增强因果推断可信度的价值。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检验线性模型中工具变量的外生性？
AI.motivation: 工具变量设计存在外生性检验的核心弱点，需要开发更可靠的检验方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于copula理论，建立了工具变量外生性与标准正态分数变换外生性之间的等价关系
AI.method: 开发了基于Wald检验的方法，在结果回归中加入正态分数变换并评估线性限制，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证性能
AI.findings: 联合版本检验在所有条件下都表现出低II类错误率，即使在重尾、不对称或双峰分布下；I类错误在高斯依赖下控制良好，但在不对称依赖下可能膨胀
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了工具变量外生性与正态分数变换外生性之间的新相关性理论结果
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的工具变量外生性检验方法，帮助研究人员在零售定价、教育回报、披露研究等领域筛选工具变量并增强因果推断的可信度

detail.abstract: Return on Investment (ROI) is often used as the primary metric for evaluating Artificial Intelligence (AI) projects. However, conventional ROI calculations tend to focus narrowly on short-term, directly attributable savings while overlooking enabling capabilities, strategic options, and risk reduction. Historical technology shifts such as the automobile, electrification, and the internet reveal that value typically emerges after complementary investments and operational redesign. This working paper explains why conventional ROI lenses can be misleading, distills lessons from past transformations, and proposes a simple “Smart ROI” framework with a practical measurement playbook for organizations.

AI.tldr: 传统ROI计算在评估AI项目时存在局限，仅关注短期直接收益而忽略战略价值。本文提出"智能ROI"框架，结合历史技术转型经验，提供更全面的AI项目评估方法。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统ROI方法在评估AI项目时会产生误导？如何构建更全面的AI项目价值评估框架？
AI.motivation: 传统ROI计算过于关注短期直接收益，忽视了AI项目的战略价值、赋能能力和风险降低等长期效益，导致对AI投资价值的低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史技术转型理论（汽车、电气化、互联网），强调技术价值通常需要互补投资和运营重构才能充分实现。
AI.method: 通过历史案例分析和理论推导，构建"智能ROI"概念框架和实用测量工具包。
AI.findings: 传统ROI方法低估AI项目价值，AI的真正价值体现在赋能能力、战略选择和风险降低等长期维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"智能ROI"理论框架，扩展了技术投资评估的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的测量工具包，帮助企业更全面地评估AI项目价值，避免投资决策偏差。

title: Use of Artificial Intelligence for Research and Academic Writing among Academic Staff in Nasarawa State University and the University of Abuja
affiliations: and Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria

detail.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence for Research and Academic Writing among Academic Staff in Nasarawa State University and the University of Abuja
detail.abstract: The application of new technologies such as Artificial Intelligence in academic research is a growing phenomenon across the globe. This has attracted the attention of researchers with a view to understanding the knowledge and capacity of AI usage in research, the degree of use, purposes and challenges. Therefore, the focus of this study is to assess the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for research and academic writing among academic staff of Nasarawa State University and the University of Abuja, Nigeria. The objectives of the study are to find out the extent, purposes and challenges of the application of AI in academic writing and research. Using the Technology Acceptance Model as its theoretical framework, the study adopted the survey design to collect data from 300 respondents through the use of questionnaire administered to staff of the two institutions. The result showed that the academics use AI to promote the development of ideas and the structuring of research methodologies, reviewing the volume of literature and synthesising them, as well as ease of data collection, sorting and analysis. Further findings also showed among others that AI is useful in terms of coding and analysis of qualitative data, checking Grammarly and spelling, editing and management of data. AI is important to academic writing and research because it provides academic writers the avenue to break down sentences, understand context, create plausible text, predict how the writer can construct and structure sentences, process large amounts of information, and assists to achieve coherence. The study concluded that though AI has significantly impacted academic research and writing, its utilisation is still at a moderate level and it is challenged by ethical issues. The researchers recommended among others that universities, polytechnics and other higher institutions of learning in Nigeria should come up with guidelines that will lead to ethical use of AI for academic writing and research.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了尼日利亚两所大学学者在学术研究和写作中使用人工智能的情况，发现AI主要用于促进思想发展、研究方法构建、文献综述、数据收集与分析等，但使用水平中等且面临伦理挑战，建议制定AI伦理使用指南。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州立大学和阿布贾大学学术人员在学术研究和写作中使用人工智能的程度、目的和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在学术研究中的应用日益普遍，需要了解学者对AI使用的知识、能力、使用程度、目的和面临的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型
AI.method: 调查研究设计，通过问卷调查从两所机构的300名受访者收集数据
AI.findings: 学者使用AI促进思想发展和研究方法构建、文献综述与综合、数据收集排序分析；AI在定性数据编码分析、语法拼写检查、编辑和数据管理方面很有用；AI帮助分解句子、理解上下文、创建合理文本、预测句子结构、处理大量信息并实现连贯性
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了技术接受模型在AI学术应用领域的适用性，为理解学者对AI技术的接受和使用行为提供了理论支持

detail.abstract: This paper is released as a perpetual preprint-not as a final statement, but as an open mathematical challenge. It aims to provoke formal reflection, critique, and expansion by mathematicians, physicists, and philosophers of science. The Epistemic Coherence Equation (ECE) is not presented as an absolute theory but as an initial condition for thought. Scholars are invited to derive, refute, generalize, or geometrize its structure within their own mathematical language and frameworks.

title: Process Data and Lie Identification in Supply Chain Collaboration
affiliations: Zhejiang University - School of Management, Zhejiang University and

detail.title: Process Data and Lie Identification in Supply Chain Collaboration
detail.abstract: With the rapid shift of supply chain collaboration to online platforms, identifying lying behavior under asymmetric information has become an increasingly critical yet challenging task. This study examines the value of process data-specifically, response times (RTs) and mouse trajectories-in distinguishing lying from truth-telling through two laboratory experiments. In our setting, a seller with private demand information sends non-binding demand messages to a manufacturer, who then decides production quantities. The seller has incentives to overstate demand to secure sufficient supply, whereas the manufacturer faces the challenge of identifying such lying behavior. We find that process data reveal systematic differences: relative to truth-telling, lying is associated with longer RTs and larger areas under the curve (AUCs). Moreover, differences in RTs and AUCs are positively correlated with sellers' harm aversion. These patterns hold across varying levels of lie detectability and in both oneshot and repeated interactions. Importantly, incorporating process data into a logistic regression model significantly improves the accuracy of lie identification, with greater improvement for sellers exhibiting higher harm aversion. Our findings demonstrate the practical value of process data for detecting lies during real-time communication in online collaborations and underscore the potential to advance process data research in operations management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两个实验室实验，检验了过程数据（反应时间和鼠标轨迹）在识别供应链在线协作中撒谎行为的价值。研究发现撒谎行为与更长的反应时间和更大的曲线下面积相关，这些差异与卖家的伤害规避程度正相关。将过程数据纳入逻辑回归模型显著提高了撒谎识别的准确性。
AI.research_question: 过程数据（反应时间和鼠标轨迹）能否有效区分供应链在线协作中的撒谎行为？
AI.motivation: 随着供应链协作向在线平台快速转移，在信息不对称情况下识别撒谎行为变得日益重要但具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、行为决策理论、过程数据理论
AI.method: 两个实验室实验，在供应链协作情境中，卖家拥有私有需求信息并向制造商发送非约束性需求信息，制造商决定生产数量。
AI.findings: 撒谎与更长的反应时间和更大的曲线下面积相关；反应时间和曲线下面积的差异与卖家的伤害规避程度正相关；这些模式在不同撒谎可检测性水平和一次性/重复互动中都成立；将过程数据纳入逻辑回归模型显著提高了撒谎识别的准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了过程数据在运营管理中的研究，为信息不对称情境下的行为识别提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了过程数据在在线协作实时沟通中检测撒谎的实际价值，为供应链管理实践提供了实用的撒谎检测工具。

title: Reuniting Forcibly Separated Families Through Shared Memories with Machine Learning
affiliations: Yale University, School of Management, Students, Yale School of Management and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Reuniting Forcibly Separated Families Through Shared Memories with Machine Learning
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Over 100,000 victims rely on self-reported, semi-structured clues on humanitarian service platforms to search for their missing parent or child. However, this setting presents significant challenges including vast search spaces, incomplete or outdated identification information, fading memories, and systematic biases in self-reported data. Despite its societal importance, the operational challenges inherent in these complex search efforts remain largely understudied. Methodology and results: We analyze semi-structured data from a large family-reunification forum and develop a retrievalaugmented entity-matching pipeline that integrates text and numerical modalities to narrow search spaces and improve human search effectiveness. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based retrieval and reranking models, showing that when combined appropriately, smaller but domain-specialized models can deliver superior performance while remaining cost-free and locally deployable for non-profit organizations. Managerial implications: Beyond directly contributing to search quality and efficiency, we demonstrate that memory-based matching tools also improve DNA collection compliance. Our proposed solution complements DNA-based matching in domestic settings and serves as a practical alternative in international settings where DNA biobanks are not shared. In doing so, it advances the design and operation of family reunification services.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个检索增强的实体匹配管道，整合文本和数值模态，用于人道主义服务平台上的家庭团聚搜索。该方法在缩小搜索空间和提高搜索效果方面优于最先进的LLM模型，同时具有成本效益和本地部署优势。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决人道主义服务平台上的家庭团聚搜索问题，克服大规模搜索空间、不完整身份信息和系统偏见等挑战？
AI.motivation: 超过10万受害者依赖人道主义服务平台上的半结构化线索寻找失散亲人，但面临搜索空间巨大、身份信息不完整、记忆模糊和系统偏见等重大挑战，而这类复杂搜索的操作挑战研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强的实体匹配理论，整合多模态信息（文本和数值）进行实体匹配，强调领域专业化模型相对于通用LLM的优势。
AI.method: 分析大型家庭团聚论坛的半结构化数据，开发检索增强的实体匹配管道，整合文本和数值模态来缩小搜索空间。
AI.findings: 该方法优于最先进的LLM检索和重排序模型，表明适当组合时，较小但领域专业化的模型能提供更优性能，同时保持免费和本地可部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了检索增强的实体匹配框架，证明了领域专业化模型在特定任务中相对于通用LLM的优势，为复杂搜索问题提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 直接提高搜索质量和效率，改善DNA收集合规性，在国内补充DNA匹配，在国际环境中作为DNA生物库不共享时的实用替代方案，推进家庭团聚服务的设计和运营。

title: Hybrid-Blockchain-Based Cross-Domain Authentication for Internet of Marine Things
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hunan University of Science and Technology, Hunan University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Providence University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Hybrid-Blockchain-Based Cross-Domain Authentication for Internet of Marine Things
detail.abstract: The Internet of Marine Things (IoMT) comprise large-scale, heterogeneous sensing devices deployed across vessels, offshore platforms, and coastal infrastructures, often partitioned into multiple administrative domains that must interoperate. Ensuring data security and privacy across these sensor networks is challenging: traditional, centrally managed authentication schemes perform poorly under low-bandwidth, high-latency maritime links, intermittent connectivity, and resource-constrained nodes, leading to inefficiency and limited resilience and reliability. For such, we propose HBCDA, hybrid-blockchain-based cross-domain authentication for IoMT that leverages public and private blockchains. A hybrid blockchain model is introduced to support efficient and secure authentication in IoMT, where the private blockchain manages inner-domain identity and the public blockchain ensures the immutability and transparency of global identity records. Moreover, a provable cross-domain authentication protocol is designed based on elliptic curve cryptography, digital signatures, and hash functions, enabling secure authentication among nodes across different domains without needing a third-party certification authority. Security analysis demonstrates the security and privacy of HBCDA, as well as the robustness against various types of attacks. Performance evaluation and analysis comparing HBCDA with state-of-the-art schemes indicate that it exhibits lower computational and communication overhead and is promising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HBCDA，一种基于混合区块链的IoMT跨域认证方案，结合公链和私链来解决海洋物联网中传统中心化认证方案在低带宽、高延迟环境下的性能问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限、网络条件恶劣的海洋物联网环境中实现安全高效的跨域认证？
AI.motivation: 传统中心化认证方案在海洋物联网的低带宽、高延迟、间歇性连接和资源受限节点环境下表现不佳，导致效率低下、韧性有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合区块链模型、椭圆曲线密码学、数字签名、哈希函数
AI.method: 设计基于混合区块链的跨域认证协议，私链管理域内身份，公链确保全局身份记录的不变性和透明度。
AI.findings: HBCDA方案在安全性和隐私保护方面表现良好，能够抵御多种攻击，且相比现有方案具有更低的计算和通信开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于海洋物联网环境的混合区块链认证理论框架，将区块链技术应用于跨域认证场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海洋物联网提供了一种无需第三方认证机构的跨域认证解决方案，提高了系统的效率和可靠性。

title: How Managers Get B2B Marketplace Scaling Wrong
affiliations: University of St. Gallen (HSG), University of Surrey, University of St. Gallen - Institute of Technology Management and University of St Gallen

detail.title: How Managers Get B2B Marketplace Scaling Wrong
detail.abstract: B2B marketplaces are experiencing a powerful resurgence, promising to simplify global sourcing amid increasing geopolitical tensions, trade tariffs and growing supply chain disruptions. However, managers strive to replicate B2C success stories but misjudge unique B2B scaling challenges. Drawing on two pioneering B2B marketplaces, we highlight how B2C platform thinking leads managers into latent scaling traps. Our cases underscore the importance of setting a viable focus, deliberate product building, as well as physical selling and right-touch service to establish and scale B2B marketplaces in traditional industries.

AI.tldr: B2B市场平台在复杂全球环境中复苏，但管理者误用B2C平台思维导致规模化陷阱。研究表明通过明确聚焦、精心产品构建、实体销售和适度服务，可在传统行业成功建立和扩展B2B市场平台。
AI.research_question: B2B市场平台如何在传统行业中成功建立和扩展，避免B2C平台思维的规模化陷阱？
AI.motivation: B2B市场平台在应对地缘政治紧张、贸易关税和供应链中断的背景下重新兴起，但管理者试图复制B2C成功模式时面临独特的B2B规模化挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台理论和B2B市场规模化理论，对比B2C与B2B平台思维的差异。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析两个先驱B2B市场平台的实践经验。
AI.findings: B2C平台思维会导致管理者陷入潜在的规模化陷阱；成功建立和扩展B2B市场平台需要：设定可行的聚焦点、精心构建产品、实体销售和适度服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了平台理论在B2B环境中的应用，识别了B2B市场平台独特的规模化挑战和成功因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了在传统行业建立和扩展B2B市场平台的具体策略，避免B2C思维陷阱，包括聚焦策略、产品开发、销售和服务方法。

title: The Political Economy and Geopolitics of AI Regulation
affiliations: London Business School, University of Surrey, The Boston Consulting Group and The Boston Consulting Group

detail.title: The Political Economy and Geopolitics of AI Regulation
detail.abstract:
Regulating AI has become a strategic battleground, yet debate remains stuck in technology and policy silos. We explain what AI regulation covers and offer a political-economy and geopolitical lens that explains who regulates AI, how, and why. At the national level, we distinguish "supplier" states, which seek leverage by producing frontier models, from the many "adopter" states that focus on use. This split-amplified by Big Tech lobbying-fragments rules and erodes market contestability. At the functional level, regulation focuses on model safety, robustness and transparency; governance of deployments in sectors and professions; and system-level integration and market structure-interoperability and portability, competition, and the allocation of data and intellectual-property rights. Drawing on comparative policy evidence and corporate cases, we diagnose three failures of the current dynamics: regulatory drift, litigation-led rule-making, and ecosystem lock-in. Moving from description to prescription, we propose layered, sector-embedded governance that separates oversight of models, deployments and systems and applies domain expertise at each layer, enabling executives and policymakers to treat regulation as deliberate market design aligned with economic and geopolitical objectives. 

In this article, Michael G. Jacobides, Annabelle Gawer, Nikolaus Lang, and David Zuluaga Martínez argue that AI regulation reflects domestic political economy and geopolitics. They urge layered, sector-embedded governance to enable AI to revitalize economies as well as check corporate concentration, align suppliers and adopters, and keep markets contestable.

title: Dynamic Spending and Portfolio Decisions with an Internal Soft Habit
affiliations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students

detail.title: Dynamic Spending and Portfolio Decisions with an Internal Soft Habit
detail.abstract: We solve the Merton problem for an agent with an infinite horizon whose utility is defined over the consumption-habit ratio, and where the curvature of the utility function jumps when consumption falls below the habit. This specification allows consumption to fall below the habit but makes such a drop especially painful. Because the model cannot be solved analytically, we solve it numerically with a method involving a double loop, where the inner loop weeds out non-feasible solutions and the outer loop picks the best of the feasible ones. We are not aware of this method having been used previously. Optimal behavior involves extensive consumption smoothing and risk taking that is high on average but significantly lowered after large, negative shocks. Simpler rules, such as a constant rates and a constant rate of withdrawal, with or without linear smoothing, reduce utility by 10 to 20 percent and require much lower risk taking to help keep withdrawals smooth. These figures are much larger than found in an earlier paper, where preferences were specified relative to an exogenous social norm rather than a habit based on past behavior. Furthermore, withdrawal rates should be significantly lower than the expected rate of portfolio return. The results should be interesting for funds like the Norwegian Government Fund Global, which motivated our study, as well as endowment funds of universities or other foundations, and pension funds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有无限期界的投资者的Merton问题，其效用函数基于消费-习惯比率，并在消费低于习惯水平时出现曲率跳跃。通过数值方法求解发现，最优策略涉及广泛的消费平滑和较高的平均风险承担，但在大负面冲击后显著降低风险。
AI.research_question: 对于具有无限期界、效用函数基于消费-习惯比率的投资者，其最优消费和投资策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究受到挪威政府全球基金等长期基金的启发，旨在为大学捐赠基金、基金会和养老基金等提供投资指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Merton投资组合选择理论，引入消费-习惯比率效用函数，其中当消费低于习惯水平时效用函数曲率发生跳跃。
AI.method: 采用数值方法求解，包含双重循环：内循环剔除不可行解，外循环选择最优可行解。
AI.findings: 最优行为涉及广泛的消费平滑和较高的平均风险承担，但在大负面冲击后显著降低风险；简单规则（如恒定提现率）会降低效用10-20%，且需要更低的风险承担来保持提现平滑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理消费-习惯比率效用函数的新数值方法，扩展了Merton问题的求解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为长期基金（如挪威政府全球基金、大学捐赠基金、养老基金）提供了具体的投资和提现策略建议，强调提现率应显著低于投资组合预期回报率。

title: Accounting for a Soviet republic: Lithuanian GDP time-series, 1940-1995
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Accounting for a Soviet republic: Lithuanian GDP time-series, 1940-1995
detail.abstract: This paper presents Lithuania’s first uninterrupted GDP per capita time series in international dollars for 1940–1995, completing a continuous 1913/1919–2024 dataset. Gathering extensive published and archival sources and applying CIA-style national accounting methods, it fills a major gap in European historical statistics. The paper also establishes a replicable framework for reconstructing GDP in other Soviet republics, opening the door for regional economic analysis of the USSR. The results reveal a catastrophic wartime decline, rapid post-war catch-up under Soviet rule, and a progressive stagnation from the 1970s onward. Growth in the 1950s and 1960s stemmed from the ‘advantages of backwardness,’ reinforced by conditional factors such as coercive Soviet industrialisation, collectivisation, and inherited social capabilities. Ultimately, the same Soviet institutions that facilitated early expansion later suppressed innovation and adaptation, binding occupied Lithuania’s economy to the wider collapse of the socialist system.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了立陶宛1940-1995年不间断的人均GDP时间序列，填补了欧洲历史统计的重大空白，揭示了苏联时期立陶宛经济的兴衰轨迹。
AI.research_question: 立陶宛在苏联时期（1940-1995）的经济表现如何？其经济增长和衰退的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 填补立陶宛历史GDP数据的空白，为苏联各加盟共和国的经济分析提供可复制的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后发优势理论，结合苏联工业化、集体化等制度因素分析。
AI.method: 收集大量已发表和档案资料，应用CIA风格的国家核算方法构建GDP时间序列。
AI.findings: 战时灾难性衰退→战后快速追赶→1970年代后渐进停滞；早期增长源于后发优势，后期苏联制度抑制创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了苏联加盟共和国GDP重建的可复制框架，深化了对后发优势理论在社会主义经济体中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域经济分析提供数据基础，揭示了苏联制度对经济发展的双重影响。

title: Intangible Asset Specificity
affiliations: University of Southern California - Leventhal School of Accounting and University of Southern California - Leventhal School of Accounting

detail.title: Intangible Asset Specificity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: At the time of writing, Richard Sloan served on the Academic Advisory Board and as consulting Director of Investment Research for Strategic Global Advisors, an institutional asset management firm and was a member of the Financial Accounting Standards Advisory Council.

detail.abstract: Kermani and Ma (2023) provide a database of asset-level liquidation recovery rates for non-financial industries. A notable feature of their data is the high average recovery rates for intangible assets, which are comparable to those of fixed assets. Using these rates, Kermani and Ma conclude that rising investment in intangibles has not significantly reduced implied firm-level liquidation values. We revisit their data and computations, showing that their high intangible recovery rates stem from including recoveries for off-balance-sheet assets in the recovery rate numerator (asset liquidation value), while excluding investments in off-balance-sheet assets from the recovery rate denominator (asset book value). After incorporating estimates of investments in off-balance-sheet intangibles in the denominator, we find that intangible recovery rates drop by an order of magnitude, and that rising investment in intangibles has reduced implied firm-level liquidation values. In contrast to Kermani and Ma, our results suggest that most intangible assets have extremely high specificity and that the increasing prevalence of intangibles has reduced firms' liquidation values.

AI.tldr: 本文重新分析了Kermani和Ma(2023)关于无形资产清算回收率的研究，发现其高估了无形资产回收率，原因是计算中包含了表外资产的回收价值但排除了表外无形资产的投资。修正后，无形资产回收率大幅下降，表明无形资产投资增加确实降低了企业清算价值。
AI.research_question: 无形资产投资增加是否降低了企业清算价值？Kermani和Ma(2023)关于无形资产高回收率的结论是否准确？
AI.motivation: Kermani和Ma(2023)发现无形资产清算回收率与固定资产相当，认为无形资产投资增加未显著降低企业清算价值，这与传统观点相悖，需要重新检验其数据和方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产清算价值理论、无形资产特异性理论、表外资产会计处理
AI.method: 重新分析Kermani和Ma的数据和计算方法，在回收率分母中纳入表外无形资产投资估计值
AI.findings: 修正计算后，无形资产回收率下降了一个数量级，无形资产投资增加确实降低了企业清算价值，大多数无形资产具有极高的特异性
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了无形资产清算回收率的测量方法，证实了无形资产高特异性理论，为无形资产估值理论提供了更准确的基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、债权人和监管机构提供了更准确的企业清算价值评估方法，有助于更准确地评估无形资产密集型企业的风险

title: Immigrant Networks in the Labor Market
affiliations: Cornell University

detail.title: Immigrant Networks in the Labor Market

declarations.funderStatement: I gratefully acknowledge research support from Alianza EFI-Colombia Científica through grant 60185 and FP44842-220-2018.

detail.abstract: Using unique survey data linked to social security records and the large influx of Venezuelan immigrants to Colombia in recent years, this paper reexamines the role played by referral networks in the labor market. By explicitly accounting for both the urban and the social space, this paper provides new insights into the mismatch between the residential location and labor outcomes of immigrants. Referrals are a critical source of information about available jobs for immigrants, particularly for recent arrivals, but struggle to improve the quality of the match between firms and workers. The misalignment between where immigrants live and where they can find suitable employment opportunities reinforces occupational downgrading and increases the persistence of informal employment.

AI.tldr: 本文使用独特的调查数据和社会安全记录，结合委内瑞拉移民大量涌入哥伦比亚的背景，重新审视了推荐网络在劳动力市场中的作用。研究发现推荐网络虽然为移民提供工作信息，但难以改善工作匹配质量，导致居住地与就业机会不匹配，加剧职业降级和非正规就业的持续性。
AI.research_question: 推荐网络在移民劳动力市场中扮演什么角色？特别是如何影响移民的居住地与就业机会匹配？
AI.motivation: 委内瑞拉移民大量涌入哥伦比亚为研究移民劳动力市场提供了独特机会，需要重新审视推荐网络在移民就业中的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场网络理论、移民就业匹配理论、空间不匹配理论
AI.method: 使用独特的调查数据与社会安全记录数据，结合大规模移民流入的自然实验设计
AI.findings: 推荐网络是移民获取工作信息的重要渠道，但难以改善工作匹配质量；居住地与就业机会不匹配加剧职业降级和非正规就业持续性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了推荐网络理论，强调了空间维度在移民就业匹配中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供实证依据，建议改善移民居住与就业的空间匹配

title: The Shadow of Uncertainty: Climate Policy and the Value of Petroleum Resources
affiliations: Norwegian School of Economics, NHH Norwegian School of Economics, Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science

detail.title: The Shadow of Uncertainty: Climate Policy and the Value of Petroleum Resources
detail.abstract: We study how perceived uncertainty associated with future decarbonization policy affects the valuation and management of oil resources. We develop a novel Climate Policy Uncertainty (CPU) index for Norway and embed it within a structural model of extraction and exploration, estimated using field-level data from the Norwegian Continental Shelf. Our findings indicate that elevated policy risk reduces the shadow prices of both discovered and undiscovered oil reserves, especially in the period following the 2015 Paris Agreement, thereby weakening incentives to extract and explore. This decline corresponds to an implicit average carbon cost of approximately \$6 per tonne of carbon dioxide, reaching up \$24 per tonne of carbon dioxide for some oilfields. Unlike a Pigouvian tax, this implicit cost does not scale with emissions intensity or generate fiscal revenue, resulting in a diffuse and economically inefficient reduction in fossil fuel production and emissions and a net welfare loss.​

AI.tldr: 本文研究了气候政策不确定性对石油资源估值和管理的影响，发现政策风险会降低已发现和未发现石油储量的影子价格，从而削弱开采和勘探的激励。
AI.research_question: 气候政策不确定性如何影响石油资源的估值和管理？
AI.motivation: 研究未来脱碳政策的不确定性对石油资源估值和管理的具体影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构模型（提取和勘探的结构模型）、影子价格理论、气候政策不确定性指数
AI.method: 开发挪威气候政策不确定性指数，并将其嵌入到使用挪威大陆架油田级数据估计的结构模型中
AI.findings: 政策风险降低了已发现和未发现石油储量的影子价格，特别是在2015年巴黎协定之后；这相当于每吨二氧化碳约6美元的隐含碳成本，某些油田可达24美元；与庇古税不同，这种隐含成本不随排放强度变化，也不产生财政收入
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了气候政策不确定性指数，建立了政策不确定性对石油资源估值影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估气候政策对石油行业影响的量化工具，揭示了政策不确定性的经济后果

title: Data-Driven Platform Encroachment
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics , , The University of Osaka - Osaka School of International Public Policy (OSIPP) and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Data-Driven Platform Encroachment

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Marketplace platforms are central players in online retail and are in an advantageous position to leverage data generated by third-party sellers. This paper analyzes how a platform's encroachment decision - whether to enter its marketplace as a direct competitor - is shaped by regulations that restrict its use of seller data. We show that the platform's encroachment decision follows a non-monotonic pattern: it enters against sellers with either relatively low or sufficiently high brand value, but remains a pure intermediary for intermediate brand values. The data ban regulation alters this strategy by making the platform more likely to exclude low brand-value sellers and more likely to accommodate high brand-value sellers. The implication is that, while such regulation can enhance competition in markets with high-value sellers, it can inadvertently harm sellers and reduce consumer surplus in emerging markets, where sellers typically lack brand recognition and depend on platform visibility. These results underscore the need for more nuanced regulatory approaches - promoting data sharing in emerging markets and targeted bans in mature, established markets - to better balance welfare and competition.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了平台在数据使用受限情况下的进入决策，发现平台会非单调地选择进入：针对品牌价值极低或极高的卖家进入竞争，但对中等品牌价值卖家保持中介角色。数据禁令使平台更可能排除低价值卖家而容纳高价值卖家，这对新兴市场卖家可能产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 数据使用限制如何影响平台作为中介或直接竞争者的进入决策？
AI.motivation: 平台在在线零售中占据核心地位，能够利用第三方卖家生成的数据，但监管可能限制这种数据使用，这会影响平台的战略决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台竞争理论、数据经济学和监管经济学，分析平台在数据使用受限下的战略选择。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建平台、卖家和消费者的博弈模型，考察不同监管情景下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 平台的进入决策呈现非单调模式：对品牌价值极低或极高的卖家进入竞争，对中等品牌价值保持中介；数据禁令使平台更倾向排除低价值卖家而容纳高价值卖家。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平台进入决策的非单调性特征，深化了对数据监管影响平台竞争策略的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管政策提供启示：新兴市场应促进数据共享，成熟市场可实施针对性数据禁令，以更好地平衡福利和竞争。

title: Peer Ties and Firm Collective Action: Evidence from a Multi-Country Survey
affiliations: , , University of Southern California - School of International Relations and

detail.title: Peer Ties and Firm Collective Action: Evidence from a Multi-Country Survey
detail.abstract: Existing scholarship shows that firms with more political ties-direct ties to government officials-are better able to influence government action. We argue that firms' peer ties-formal and informal connections to other firms-also play a distinct and valuable role, enabling firms to act collectively by providing a means for sharing information and imposing social rewards and sanctions. We also theorize that collective action is easier when firms are pursuing broad objectives, like changes to tax and regulatory policy, that benefit many firms as opposed to regulatory and tax exemptions that benefit individual firms. To test our theory, we introduce novel, firm-level data covering seven countries in Southeast Asia. Consistent with our theory, firms with more peer ties are more likely to act collectively; collective action is more likely when firms are pursuing broad objectives; and better-connected firms are more likely to achieve political success.

AI.tldr: 企业间的同侪关系（正式和非正式的企业间联系）在政治影响力中发挥独特作用，使企业能够通过信息共享和社会奖惩机制采取集体行动。当企业追求广泛的税收和监管政策目标时，集体行动更容易实现。
AI.research_question: 企业间的同侪关系如何影响企业的集体政治行动及其成功？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业与政府的直接政治联系，但忽视了企业间同侪关系在政治影响力中的独特作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体行动理论、社会网络理论、企业政治战略理论
AI.method: 使用涵盖东南亚七个国家的新颖企业层面数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 拥有更多同侪关系的企业更可能采取集体行动；追求广泛政策目标时集体行动更易发生；联系更紧密的企业更可能获得政治成功
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业政治影响力理论，强调了同侪关系在集体行动中的独特作用，区分了广泛目标与个体豁免的集体行动差异
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过同侪网络有效参与政治过程提供实践指导，帮助理解集体政治行动的成功条件

title: Influence of Media Narratives on Climate Change Perception and Policy Action

detail.title: Influence of Media Narratives on Climate Change Perception and Policy Action
detail.abstract: This study investigated how media narratives coalesce with public understanding of climate change and how this nexus autonomously or dependently affects policy formulation. Through a comparative analysis of about two decades of coverage, the investigation traced how framing devices map the salience of climate phenomena, the resulting societal effects, and the translation of both into or away from affirmative legislative cycles. Utilising a library-oriented, multi-language archive, the methodology interwove framing and agenda-setting inquiry with peer-reviewed journals, meta-analyses, grey literature, and datasets from both content analysis and semi-structured interviews. Findings revealed that portrayals centred on cataclysmic thresholds typically evoked either hyper-vigilant maladaptation or a dispassionate paralysis, while accounts qualifying that danger with achievable mitigation milestones fostered citizenship-engaged persistence. Ideological contamination of the coverage, especially sensationalised partisanship that discretely reframed findings, corrupted consensus framing and attenuated socio-political solidarity. The report therefore affirmed that factually layered and disaggregated accounts, communicating uncertainty in proportion to its scientific weighting, are critical to sustaining a granular public and legislative discourse. Recommendations underscore the imperative of systematic media literacy curricula, the institutional embedding of journalist-academic collaboration on climate datasets, and policy-regulatory frameworks that reward transparent and data-rich climate reporting in conscious civic awareness-building.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨媒体叙事如何影响公众对气候变化的理解，以及这种关系如何影响政策制定。研究发现，灾难性报道易引发过度警惕或冷漠，而包含可行缓解方案的报道则促进公民参与。意识形态污染会破坏共识框架，因此需要事实分层、透明数据丰富的报道来维持有效的公共讨论。
AI.research_question: 媒体叙事如何与公众对气候变化的理解融合，以及这种关系如何自主或依赖地影响政策制定？
AI.motivation: 理解媒体叙事在塑造公众认知和政策制定过程中的作用，特别是在气候变化这一复杂议题上。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架理论和议程设置理论
AI.method: 比较分析约二十年的媒体报道，结合框架和议程设置研究，整合同行评审期刊、元分析、灰色文献、内容分析和半结构化访谈数据
AI.findings: 灾难性阈值描述易引发过度警惕或冷漠，而包含可行缓解方案的报道促进公民参与；意识形态污染破坏共识框架，削弱社会政治团结
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了框架理论和议程设置理论在气候变化议题中的应用，揭示了叙事类型对公众反应和政策影响的具体机制
AI.practical_contributions: 建议系统媒体素养课程、记者与学者在气候数据上的制度化合作，以及奖励透明数据丰富报道的政策监管框架

title: Public Relations Measurement and Evaluation beyond Media Mentions: Insights from the Nigerian Context

detail.title: Public Relations Measurement and Evaluation beyond Media Mentions: Insights from the Nigerian Context

publicationDetails.detailsText: Social Science and Human Research Bulletin, volume 02, issue 09, 2025[10.55677/SSHRB/2025-3050-0904]

detail.abstract: Public Relations (public relations (PR) is increasingly recognized as a strategic communication function that strengthens organizational legitimacy, nurtures trust, and manages reputation in complex social and political environments. In Nigeria, yet it must be acknowledged, public relations (PR) measurement has traditionally relied on narrow indicators such as press clippings, media mentions, and publicity reports. These media-centric methods privilege visibility over effectiveness and fall short of adequately to capture public relations (PR)'s broader contributions to stakeholder relationships, behavioral outcomes, and societal impact. Anchored on Excellence Theory, which frames public relations (PR) as a strategic management function, and the Barcelona Principles of Communication Measurement and Evaluation, which emphasize outcomeoriented, transparent, and multidimensional systematic assessment, this conceptual paper interrogates the limitations of traditional systematic assessment conceptual approaches when examined within the Nigerian socio-political and cultural context. Drawing on both global scholarship and Nigerian literature, it examines the cultural, institutional, and political factors that have shaped local practices and hindered methodological innovation. The study proposes a holistic conceptual approach that integrates international best practices with Nigeria's contextual realities, encouraging practitioners to embrace methods that combine qualitative and quantitative metrics. It recommends three key steps: abandoning outdated metrics such as Advertising Value Equivalence (AVE); adopting the Barcelona Principles to align communication with organizational and societal goals; and fostering collaboration between academia, practitioners, and professional associations to develop locally relevant standards. By advancing this multidimensional and context-sensitive perspective, the paper contributes to theory-building in public relations (PR) and offers practical insights for redefining systematic assessment when examined within the Nigerian socio-political and cultural context. Ultimately, it contends that rigorous and credible systematic assessment practices are essential for enhancing the profession's accountability, relevance, and long-term impact.

AI.tldr: 本文批判尼日利亚传统公关评估方法过于依赖媒体指标，提出基于卓越理论和巴塞罗那原则的整合性评估框架，强调结合国际最佳实践与本地情境，推动公关评估从媒体曝光转向多维度的效果衡量。

title: Harnessing Radio as Development Tool for Building Nasarawa State University's Image in Nigeria
affiliations: Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria, Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria, Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria, Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria and

detail.title: Harnessing Radio as Development Tool for Building Nasarawa State University's Image in Nigeria
detail.abstract: This paper on harnessing radio as a development tool for promoting Nasarawa State University's image in Nigeria is carried out to reveal the importance of radio in disseminating information to the public on salient issues of concern in Nasarawa State University to attract more recognition across the country and on the global scene. Important policies such as the whistleblowing tagged “See Something Say Something” and a nip in the bud to curtail students' unethical practices are issues of top priority that need to be publicised for the Nasarawa State University publics to know. This will improve the perception of people about the university to be seen in the light of operating according to the standard practices world over. An in-depth review of literature is used to unearth how radio was used in the past to build Nigeria's image in 2009 by Late Dora Akunyili and how it can be used today to project the image of the university. The paper concluded that timely dissemination of information by the university using the widest reach broadcast medium can improve the image of the Nasarawa State University in the minds of its publics. Therefore, the university should endeavor to utilise radio to inform Nigerians of its developmental policies to attract positive perceptions from all and sundry.

detail.abstract: This Special Issue of TGPPP addresses the accelerating convergence between GenAI, Urban AI, and public governance. As algorithmic systems are deployed across domains such as transport, welfare, housing, education, and security, cities become both laboratories of innovation and battlegrounds of democratic legitimacy. Trustworthy AI has emerged as a policy imperative-but the question remains: trustworthy for whom? Rather than treating trust as a static feature of technical systems, this Special Issue reframes it as a relational, contested, and institutionally mediated concept-fundamental to the legitimacy of public action in the digital age. Contributions are encouraged that explore GenAI not only as a technological advance, but as a governance challenge that reconfigures discretion, authority, and the social contract between citizens and institutions. Inspired by Richard R. Nelson's enduring metaphor of "The Moon and the Ghetto"-which captures the asymmetries between technological sophistication and social equity-this Special Issue invites a renewed interrogation of how AI policy can bridge systemic inequalities rather than entrench them. Urban governance frameworks must move beyond techno-solutionism to embed pluralism, accountability, and public value at the core of GenAI deployments. Scholars, policymakers, and practitioners are invited to submit empirical, theoretical, and policy-oriented contributions that critically examine how Urban AI can be governed with legitimacy, reflexivity, and justice.

title: Talking through a Crisis: The Value of Interactive Investor Communication During Trading Halts
affiliations: Foster School of Business, University of Washington and Fudan University-the School of Management

detail.title: Talking through a Crisis: The Value of Interactive Investor Communication During Trading Halts
detail.abstract: We investigate the value of interactive investor communication during price-induced trading halts. Investors increase questions to management during bad news halts, but not during good news halts. Questions posted during bad news halts focus on unusual corporate events, potentially illegal activities, or lawsuits. Using a return-matched design, we find that increased investor communication during a halt is associated with higher post-halt market liquidity. Furthermore, we show this improvement in liquidity is strongest when the company response: (a) directly addresses concerns raised by investor questions, (b) is made in a timely manner, and (c) is more specific and quantitative in nature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了价格引发的交易暂停期间投资者互动沟通的价值。研究发现，投资者在负面消息暂停期间会增加向管理层提问，这些提问关注异常公司事件、潜在非法活动或诉讼。通过收益匹配设计，发现暂停期间增加的投资者沟通与暂停后市场流动性提高相关，且当公司回应直接、及时、具体时，流动性改善效果最强。
AI.research_question: 价格引发的交易暂停期间投资者互动沟通的价值是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究交易暂停期间投资者沟通对市场流动性的影响，特别是在不同消息性质（好消息vs坏消息）下的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和市场微观结构理论，探讨投资者沟通如何缓解信息不对称并改善市场流动性。
AI.method: 采用收益匹配设计，分析交易暂停期间投资者提问行为与暂停后市场流动性的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 投资者在坏消息暂停期间提问增加，好消息暂停期间不增加；2) 坏消息暂停期间的提问关注异常事件、非法活动或诉讼；3) 暂停期间增加的投资者沟通与暂停后市场流动性提高相关；4) 当公司回应直接、及时、具体时，流动性改善效果最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了投资者沟通在交易暂停情境下的理论价值，揭示了信息沟通在缓解市场不确定性中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上市公司在交易暂停期间如何有效回应投资者关切提供了实践指导，强调了直接、及时、具体的沟通策略对改善市场流动性的重要性。

title: Use of Social Media Platforms for Public Enlightenment of NIN-SIM Card Registration in Nigeria
affiliations: , Nasarawa State University, Keffi Nasarawa State  Nigeria and Nasarawa State University

detail.title: Use of Social Media Platforms for Public Enlightenment of NIN-SIM Card Registration in Nigeria
detail.abstract: The primary aim of the study was to evaluate the impact of social media on public awareness of NIN-SIM card registration in Nigeria. For this case study, the Technology Acceptance Model was applied. The model seeks to explain how and why individuals adopt new technologies, particularly in relation to new information communication systems, and further clarifies the primary reasons for adoption, recognition, acceptance, and application of such technologies. The study employed a scoping review. The results of the investigation indicated that the majority of social media platforms were highly effective in facilitating the integration of various groups into broad government initiatives such as the SIM card-NIN registration policy. The findings revealed that, in relation to Nigeria's SIM card-National Identification Number (NIN) registration initiative, social media platforms such as X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, YouTube, and others were utilised with great precision to raise policy awareness among the populace. The paper deduced that, in the Nigerian context, social media platforms like X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, YouTube, etc., are instrumental in broadcasting information about government policies. The paper recommends that the Government of Nigeria should initiate and implement a positive social media policy framework aimed at encouraging effective public participation in government policies and programmes. Furthermore, there is a need to monitor information on social media to ensure its quality, reliability, confidentiality, and privacy, especially in matters relating to national security. The credibility of sources should also be taken into account to ensure the authenticity of the information being shared.

detail.abstract: This article challenges the Anglo-centric narrative of video game history by examining how the 1983 U.S. market collapse created unique opportunities for the emergence of a distinctive gaming culture in Mexico. Through historical and cultural analysis, we explore how informal distribution networks (fayuca) generated diffuse power dynamics (Foucault, 1977) and cultivated a "discipline of ingenuity" that shaped digital entertainment consumption. We analyze Nintendo's rise in Mexico as a process of cultural hegemony (Gramsci, 1971) facilitated by Club Nintendo magazine, then trace gaming's massification through CD-ROM piracy and console rental establishments. Finally, we examine the current "Cambrian explosion" of consumption niches and digital asset monetization, demonstrating that Mexican gamer identity-forged in resilience and adaptation-has evolved into a diversification that not only reflects the country's socioeconomic complexities but transforms leisure into investment. This research proposes an alternative model emphasizing diffuse power, ingenuity discipline, and consensus hegemony in forming a unique, resilient gaming culture.

title: Rigor Theater is Not Enough: Navigating Two Habitus in Management Learning
affiliations: Tongji University

detail.title: Rigor Theater is Not Enough: Navigating Two Habitus in Management Learning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: This paper examines tensions in management education between what I term a "habitus of rigor" and a "habitus of relevance." The habitus of rigor emphasizes methodological sophistication, theoretical contribution, and procedural correctness, producing what those positioned outside this orientation might construct as "rigor theater"-elaborate performances satisfying academic gatekeepers. The habitus of relevance emphasizes contextual judgment, practical wisdom, and theory as a resource for questioning actions in specific contexts. Through interpretive analysis of documented editorial patterns and institutional dynamics, I demonstrate that these represent orthogonal dimensions, creating navigable space rather than opposing poles that require a choice. Current gatekeeping may constrain navigation by privileging movement along the rigor axis while blocking movement along the relevance axis. However, participants are positioned differently and construct these dynamics in various ways. The emergence of AI tools exposes these dynamics by revealing that much of what rigor habitus values can be automated. I conclude by exploring institutional possibilities that might open navigation, enabling doctoral students to construct varied journeys through this space rather than being channeled onto prescribed paths. The framework's value lies not in capturing objective truth about management education but in making visible the dynamics participants experience when they lack the language to examine them reflexively.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨管理教育中"严谨性惯习"与"相关性惯习"之间的张力，认为它们是正交维度而非对立两极。当前学术把关机制偏向严谨性维度，限制了相关性维度的探索。AI工具的出现揭示了严谨性惯习中许多价值可被自动化，为重新构想管理教育提供了机会。
AI.research_question: 管理教育中"严谨性惯习"与"相关性惯习"之间的张力如何影响学术实践？这些张力如何通过制度动态和把关机制被建构和维持？
AI.motivation: 当前管理教育中存在学术严谨性与实践相关性之间的紧张关系，这种张力限制了学者和学生的多元发展路径，需要新的框架来理解和导航这种复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 布迪厄的惯习理论，将严谨性和相关性视为两种不同的学术惯习；制度理论，分析学术把关机制如何塑造这些惯习的实践。
AI.method: 解释性分析，通过对文档化的编辑模式和制度动态进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 严谨性惯习与相关性惯习是正交维度而非对立两极；当前学术把关机制偏向严谨性维度；AI工具揭示了严谨性惯习中许多价值可被自动化；参与者对这些动态有不同的建构方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"严谨性惯习"和"相关性惯习"的概念框架；挑战了严谨性与相关性二元对立的传统观点；为理解学术实践中的制度约束提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理教育机构重新设计博士培养路径提供理论支持；帮助学者和学生更清晰地导航学术职业发展；为应对AI时代学术评价体系的变革提供洞见。

title: Science by Consensus: Eliciting Citizens’ and Experts’ R&D Spending Priorities
affiliations: University of Barcelona - Institut d'Economia de Barcelona (IEB), UniDistance Suisse and University of Warwick

detail.title: Science by Consensus: Eliciting Citizens’ and Experts’ R&D Spending Priorities

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Research and development (R&D) is thought to be an important determinant of improvements in living standards, health, and economic security. Yet, U.S. government spending on R&D has fallen over time, with further cuts proposed. Two standard rationalizations for such cuts are: (i) citizens support such cuts, and (ii) the marginal social return from R&D is low. We test these using surveys with U.S. citizens and experts. Our evidence rejects both: a large majority of citizens do not favor cuts and, on the contrary, prefer increasing R&D spending; and a large majority of experts judge the marginal social returns from increasing R&D spending to be high, with the average belief placing benefits at about $3 per dollar invested. Experts underestimate public support, indicating that they misperceive the political feasibility of increasing R&D spending.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查美国公民和专家，发现大多数公民不支持削减研发支出，反而希望增加；专家认为增加研发支出的边际社会回报很高（约3美元/每美元投资）。专家低估了公众支持度，误解了增加研发支出的政治可行性。
AI.research_question: 美国公民是否支持削减研发支出？增加研发支出的边际社会回报是否较低？
AI.motivation: 美国政府对研发的支出持续下降且有进一步削减提议，需要检验削减研发支出的两个标准理由是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共政策偏好理论和边际社会回报评估理论，分析公众对研发支出的态度和专家对研发投资回报的判断。
AI.method: 使用针对美国公民和专家的调查问卷方法，收集定量数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 大多数公民不支持削减研发支出，反而偏好增加；2) 大多数专家认为增加研发支出的边际社会回报很高（平均约3:1的收益成本比）；3) 专家低估了公众对增加研发支出的支持度。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了削减研发支出的两个标准理论假设，提供了关于公众政策偏好和专家认知偏差的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要参考：增加研发支出在公众支持度和经济回报方面都具有可行性，应重新考虑削减研发支出的政策方向。

title: Emerging Growth Industries: Small-Cap vs. Large-Cap Volatility Divergence from Traditional Patterns
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Emerging Growth Industries: Small-Cap vs. Large-Cap Volatility Divergence from Traditional Patterns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Gladys Teng helped me with this research as a part of the Nova program.

detail.abstract: Although there is comprehensive research on sensitivity of large-cap and small-cap stocks to macroeconomic shocks, a significant gap remains regarding whether these relationships persist within emerging high-growth industries that are increasingly significant in the modern economy. This study analyzes lead-lag relationships between macroeconomic factors (Federal Funds Rate (FFR) and Consumer Price Index (CPI)) and three prominent emerging industries: biotechnology, clean energy, and robotics from 2005 to 2025 (macroeconomic factors only 2013-2021). It also tracks the relationship between the same macroeconomic indicators and volatility of stocks based on capitalization (small-cap and large-cap, represented by the Russell 2000 Volatility Index (RVX) and the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX)). Using Granger causality and cross-correlation analyses on daily returns, I find that VIX consistently leads RVX, confirming the information flow hypothesis from liquid large-caps to less efficient small-caps. However, the Autoregressive Distributed Lag Model (ARDL) reveals that broad market volatility does not consistently drive the emerging sectors of the economy. Instead, it identifies such interdependencies as a strong bidirectional relationship between robotics and clean energy and robotics leading biotech. These findings suggest that emerging growth industries are primarily driven by technological innovations and policies rather than broad market trends, questioning conventional approaches to creating and managing portfolios and challenging the traditional view of this newly established sector as a uniform asset class.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了宏观经济因素（联邦基金利率和消费者价格指数）与三个新兴行业（生物技术、清洁能源和机器人技术）之间的领先-滞后关系，以及这些因素与小盘股和大盘股波动率的关系。研究发现市场波动率并不持续驱动新兴行业，而是新兴行业内部存在强烈的双向关系，表明这些行业主要受技术创新和政策驱动而非广泛市场趋势影响。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济因素与新兴高增长行业之间是否存在领先-滞后关系？这些关系是否与传统的市值分类股票对宏观经济冲击的敏感性模式一致？
AI.motivation: 尽管对大盘股和小盘股对宏观经济冲击的敏感性有全面研究，但对于在现代经济中日益重要的新兴高增长行业是否保持这些关系存在显著研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息流假说（从流动性强的大盘股流向效率较低的小盘股）、新兴行业驱动因素理论、资产组合管理理论
AI.method: 使用格兰杰因果关系和互相关分析日收益率数据，并应用自回归分布滞后模型（ARDL）
AI.findings: VIX持续领先RVX，确认信息从大盘股流向小盘股；但广泛市场波动率并不持续驱动新兴行业；机器人技术与清洁能源之间存在强双向关系，机器人技术领先生物技术
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将新兴行业视为统一资产类别的传统观点，提出了新兴行业主要受技术创新和政策驱动而非广泛市场趋势的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 质疑传统的投资组合创建和管理方法，为投资者在新兴行业投资决策提供新的视角，强调需要关注行业特定的技术创新和政策因素

title: LLMs Change Everything: A Hybrid Model for Literature Review Training in Doctoral Management Education
affiliations: ISTEC Business School and Tongji University

detail.title: LLMs Change Everything: A Hybrid Model for Literature Review Training in Doctoral Management Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: Doctoral students in management face an impossible task: demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of exponentially expanding literatures while conducting substantial empirical research. With publications offering dramatically comprehensive coverage, it has become cognitively overwhelming. However, the crisis involves more than volume-we also face a literacy crisis where students lack critical reading skills, resulting in superficial literature reviews that fail to develop essential scholarly competencies. This paper proposes a hybrid pedagogical model that leverages AI/LLM tools for literature landscape mapping and ongoing awareness, while preserving and enhancing human development of critical reading through deep engagement with carefully selected sources. Drawing on constructivist pedagogy and orthogonal dimensions theory, we present a six-phase approach reallocating 30-40% of literature time toward empirical engagement. The framework includes explicit critical reading pedagogy, LLM-assisted paper selection, boundary training for responsible AI use, and concrete implementation guidance. We demonstrate that computational support and human judgment represent complementary capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出混合教学模型，利用AI工具进行文献图谱绘制和持续跟踪，同时通过深度阅读精选文献来培养批判性阅读能力，重新分配30-40%的文献时间用于实证研究。
AI.research_question: 如何在管理博士生教育中平衡文献综述的广度需求与批判性阅读能力的培养？
AI.motivation: 管理博士生面临认知超负荷的困境：既要掌握指数级增长的文献，又要进行实质性实证研究，同时还存在批判性阅读技能不足的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建构主义教学法和正交维度理论
AI.method: 六阶段混合教学模型，包括明确的批判性阅读教学、LLM辅助论文选择、AI使用边界训练和具体实施指导
AI.findings: 计算支持和人类判断代表互补能力，通过重新分配文献时间可以提升实证参与度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合AI工具与人类批判性思维的混合教学框架，重新定义了文献综述在博士生培养中的角色
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理博士生教育提供了具体的教学实施指南，帮助学生在文献广度与深度之间找到平衡

title: Charles R. Geisst, Just Price in the Markets: A History (book review)
affiliations: European University Institute - Department of Law (LAW)

detail.title: Charles R. Geisst, Just Price in the Markets: A History (book review)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I disclose that I do not have any financial or non-financial interests directly or indirectly related to the work submitted for publication. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for- profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Charles R. Geisst's latest book culminates in his long list of publications on financial markets, big business, and economic justice. In this work, the author adopts the historical perspective to study the metaphysical concept of a 'just price,' by guiding readers through considerations in the fields of ethics, law, and economics. Just Price in the Markets: A History (2023) is a much-needed book in a time when the importance of the history of ideas appears to be belittled.

AI.tldr: 本书从历史视角研究"公正价格"这一形而上学概念，通过伦理、法律和经济领域的考量，探讨金融市场中的公平定价问题。
AI.research_question: 什么是公正价格？如何在金融市场中实现公平定价？
AI.motivation: 在当前思想史重要性被轻视的时代，需要重新审视公正价格这一古老概念的现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伦理、法律和经济学的跨学科理论框架，结合历史分析方法。
AI.method: 采用历史视角，通过文献分析和概念梳理的方法研究公正价格。
AI.findings: 公正价格是一个复杂的形而上学概念，需要在伦理、法律和经济多个维度进行综合考量。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新激活了公正价格这一古老概念在现代金融研究中的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融市场参与者提供了关于公平定价的历史智慧和伦理指导。

title: Residual  Expansion Approach for a Deep Learning Based Inverse Mapping Model Calibration
affiliations: Kanagawa University

detail.title: Residual  Expansion Approach for a Deep Learning Based Inverse Mapping Model Calibration
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the residual expansion approach (REA), a novel framework for deep learning-based inverse-mapping model calibration. In contrast to the conventional methods that rely on computationally expensive and unstable numerical optimization, REA directly infers model parameters from market observations such as option prices and implied volatilities. Starting from a simple base model, either an analytical approximation or a neural-network estimator, the method iteratively refines parameter estimates by learning residual corrections. Through this process, REA enhances numerical stability, accuracy, and interpretability while mitigating the effects of local minima. Once trained, the framework enables efficient real-time calibration: when the base is an inverse-mapping network, parameters can be inferred directly without any numerical optimization, and when the base is an analytical approximation, only a lightweight calibration step is required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的深度学习方法REA，用于逆映射模型校准，通过从简单基础模型迭代学习残差修正来直接推断模型参数，避免了传统数值优化的计算成本和稳定性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高效、稳定且可解释的深度学习方法来进行逆映射模型校准？
AI.motivation: 传统基于数值优化的方法存在计算成本高、数值不稳定、容易陷入局部最优等问题，需要一种更高效可靠的校准方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 残差扩展方法(REA)框架，结合深度学习和残差学习理论，通过迭代残差修正来改进参数估计。
AI.method: 从简单基础模型（解析近似或神经网络估计器）出发，通过迭代学习残差修正来逐步优化参数估计。
AI.findings: REA方法提高了数值稳定性、准确性和可解释性，同时减轻了局部最小值的影响，支持高效的实时校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了残差扩展方法的理论框架，为深度学习的逆映射模型校准提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了高效的实时校准：当基础为逆映射网络时无需数值优化，当基础为解析近似时仅需轻量级校准步骤。

title: Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards in India and Pakistan: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: Humboldt University Berlin

detail.title: Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards in India and Pakistan: A Comparative Analysis
detail.abstract:
This thesis presents a comparative analysis of the enforcement of foreign arbitral awards in India and Pakistan within the framework of the 1958 New York Convention. Both jurisdictions, sharing a common legal heritage rooted in the British common law system, have taken divergent paths in incorporating and interpreting the Convention in their domestic legislation—the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 in India and the Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Act 2011 in Pakistan.

The study examines how each country’s judiciary and legislative framework align with the spirit of the New York Convention, focusing on key issues such as reciprocity and commercial reservations, exclusion of domestic arbitration law, public policy exceptions, appeal mechanisms, and standards of judicial review. It also explores topical issues including the arbitrability of shareholders’ disputes, extension of arbitration clauses to non-signatories, incapacity of parties, and stamp duty on foreign awards.

Findings reveal that Indian jurisprudence, though extensive, often reflects a restrictive and formalistic interpretation of the Convention, particularly regarding public policy and reciprocity reservations. In contrast, Pakistan has demonstrated a more consistent pro-enforcement bias and closer adherence to the Convention’s objectives, largely due to its 2011 legislation and judicial restraint in expanding grounds for refusal. However, Pakistan’s case law remains less developed in addressing modern issues such as non-signatory enforcement and complex commercial disputes.

The thesis concludes that both jurisdictions can benefit from mutual learning—India from Pakistan’s alignment with the Convention’s enforcement mandate, and Pakistan from India’s judicial innovation in evolving arbitration jurisprudence. Through convergence toward the pro-enforcement spirit of the New York Convention, both states can strengthen their credibility as arbitration-friendly regimes in South Asia.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较分析了印度和巴基斯坦在1958年《纽约公约》框架下执行外国仲裁裁决的情况。研究发现印度对公约采取限制性解释，而巴基斯坦更符合公约的执行导向精神。两国可相互借鉴以提升仲裁友好度。
AI.research_question: 印度和巴基斯坦在《纽约公约》框架下执行外国仲裁裁决的比较分析是什么？
AI.motivation: 两个拥有共同普通法传统的司法管辖区在纳入和解释《纽约公约》时采取了不同路径，值得比较研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 1958年《纽约公约》框架、比较法学理论、仲裁法理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，分析两国立法框架和司法实践
AI.findings: 印度对公约采取限制性解释，巴基斯坦更符合公约执行导向；印度案例法更丰富但限制性强，巴基斯坦案例法较少但更符合公约精神
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了《纽约公约》在不同普通法国家的实施比较研究，为仲裁法理论提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为两国改进仲裁制度提供建议，促进南亚地区仲裁友好环境建设

title: Peer to Peer Lending Platforms in Pakistan: Risks and Regulatory Gaps
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Peer to Peer Lending Platforms in Pakistan: Risks and Regulatory Gaps
detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolution of peer-to-peer (P2P) lending platforms in Pakistan and the factors contributing to their slow adoption. It further investigates the risks associated with these platforms, particularly in the absence of a comprehensive regulatory framework for their governance. The paper highlights the need for policy development and regulatory oversight to ensure the sustainable growth of P2P lending in Pakistan’s financial ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了巴基斯坦P2P借贷平台的演变及其采用缓慢的原因，分析了缺乏监管框架带来的风险，并强调了政策发展和监管监督的必要性。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦P2P借贷平台发展缓慢的原因是什么？缺乏监管框架会带来哪些风险？
AI.motivation: P2P借贷在巴基斯坦发展缓慢，缺乏适当的监管框架，需要研究其发展障碍和风险，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融创新理论、监管框架理论、风险管理理论
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究、政策分析
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦P2P借贷平台发展缓慢，主要障碍包括缺乏监管框架、用户信任度低、风险意识不足；缺乏监管导致系统性风险和投资者保护问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家P2P借贷发展的理论研究，提供了监管框架对金融创新影响的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦监管机构制定P2P借贷政策提供建议，促进该行业的可持续发展，保护投资者利益。

title: Immigrant Poetics and Cultural Capital: The Serezian Model of Emotional Transformation
affiliations: Independent Author & Researcher, USA

detail.title: Immigrant Poetics and Cultural Capital: The Serezian Model of Emotional Transformation
detail.abstract: This article introduces a novel theoretical model for understanding immigrant creativity through the literary works of Turkish-American poet Safak Serez. The study argues that displacement, trauma, and cultural in-betweenness act not as sources of loss but as catalysts for artistic innovation and cultural contribution. Drawing on the concepts of narrative identity, hybrid emotional language, and self-authored belonging, the article proposes the "Serezian Model of Emotional Transformation." This model demonstrates how poetic expression converts marginalization into symbolic power, enabling immigrants to transition from invisibility to cultural capital within their host societies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过土耳其裔美国诗人Safak Serez的文学作品，提出了理解移民创造力的新理论模型。研究表明，流离失所、创伤和文化中间状态不是损失来源，而是艺术创新和文化贡献的催化剂。
AI.research_question: 移民的流离失所、创伤和文化中间状态如何转化为艺术创新和文化贡献？
AI.motivation: 探索移民经历中的边缘化状态如何通过文学创作转变为文化资本，挑战传统对移民创伤的消极理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事身份、混合情感语言、自我归属建构、Serezian情感转化模型
AI.method: 通过分析土耳其裔美国诗人Safak Serez的文学作品进行理论建模
AI.findings: 诗歌表达能够将边缘化转化为象征性力量，使移民从隐形状态转变为具有文化资本的地位
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Serezian情感转化模型，重新概念化移民创伤与创造力之间的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解移民文学创作提供新视角，展示了艺术表达在文化适应过程中的积极作用

reference: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18245
title: Evaluators’ Masculine Gender Identity May Drive Gender Biases in Peer Evaluation of Business Plans
affiliations: Masaryk University, Masaryk University - Department of Public Economics and Slovak Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Evaluators’ Masculine Gender Identity May Drive Gender Biases in Peer Evaluation of Business Plans

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The paper investigates gender biases and differential treatment of women and men in the business start-up phase. A sample of 498 entrepreneurs from Slovakia participated in an online experiment and evaluated three fictitious business plans in terms of the applicants’ competence, likeability, and business ability. The start-ups were positioned in three different sectors—cosmetics production, services provision, and software development— where men’s and women’s chances of success may be viewed differently. Following Goldberg’s paradigm, half of the evaluators received business plans presented as written by female and half by male applicants; otherwise the plans were identical. Results imply that female applicants are assessed similarly to male applicants, but more masculine evaluators assess women’s business plans and their potential in entrepreneurship more critically. The study advises caution in recommending more female evaluators in the business plan assessment. If women who become involved in entrepreneurship are excessively masculine and masculinity is associated with a less favourable evaluation of potential female entrepreneurs, such policies could backfire against women, putting them in a more disadvantaged position.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在线实验发现，女性创业者在商业计划评估中与男性获得相似评价，但更男性化的评估者会对女性创业计划给予更苛刻的评价。研究建议谨慎增加女性评估者，因为过度男性化的女性评估者可能反而对女性创业者不利。
AI.research_question: 在创业启动阶段，是否存在基于性别的偏见和对男女创业者的差异化对待？
AI.motivation: 探讨创业领域中的性别偏见问题，特别是在商业计划评估阶段是否存在系统性偏见，影响女性创业者的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Goldberg范式，研究性别刻板印象和评估偏见在创业领域的表现。
AI.method: 采用在线实验方法，498名斯洛伐克企业家评估三个虚构商业计划（化妆品生产、服务提供、软件开发），一半评估者被告知计划由女性撰写，另一半由男性撰写，实际计划内容相同。
AI.findings: 女性申请者与男性申请者获得相似评价，但更男性化的评估者对女性商业计划和创业潜力评价更苛刻。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了性别偏见理论在创业领域的应用，揭示了评估者性别特质而非生理性别对评价的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业政策制定提供重要启示：单纯增加女性评估者可能无法解决性别偏见问题，需要关注评估者的性别特质构成。

title: The Protective Effect and Boundary Conditions of CEO Social Networks: Evidence from Corporate Climate Risk
affiliations: Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Guizhou University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: The Protective Effect and Boundary Conditions of CEO Social Networks: Evidence from Corporate Climate Risk
detail.abstract: Amid deepening global climate governance and corporate environmental challenges, this study elevates climate risk management from passive compliance to proactive governance, examining its impact on corporate sustainability. Grounded in an integrated framework of upper echelons theory, institutional theory, and resource dependence theory, we analyze A-share listed companies in China from 2015 to 2023 to investigate the protective effect of CEO social networks on corporate climate risk and its boundary conditions. Using textual analysis of annual reports to measure climate risk exposure, we find that CEO social networks significantly reduce corporate climate risk. This protective effect remains robust after addressing endogeneity concerns and conducting rigorous sensitivity tests, including alternative variable measurements and fixed-effects specifications. However, we identify three critical boundary conditions. First, corporate carbon emission intensity positively moderates this relationship, with the protective effect being most pronounced in high-emission firms. Second, CEOs' overseas experience unexpectedly weakens the network effect, revealing a cognitive boundary. Third, regional environmental regulation intensity strengthens the network effect, demonstrating institutional reinforcement. Mechanism analysis shows that CEO social networks mitigate climate risk primarily through promoting corporate digital transformation. From a capital market perspective, high climate risk firms face financing differentiation: while attracting patient capital, they encounter exclusion from green finance, reflecting heterogeneous market assessment of climate risk. This study contributes by systematically examining the protective effect and multidimensional boundaries of CEO social networks, advancing theoretical understanding of formal and informal institutional interactions in environmental governance. Our findings offer practical insights for firms building climate resilience, investors identifying environmental risks, and regulators refining policy design, with direct implications for optimizing executive team composition and balancing capital structure in complex institutional environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于高阶理论、制度理论和资源依赖理论，分析2015-2023年中国A股上市公司，发现CEO社会网络显著降低企业气候风险，主要通过促进企业数字化转型实现。研究发现三个关键边界条件：碳排放强度正向调节、海外经验负向调节、环境规制强度正向调节。高气候风险企业在资本市场面临融资分化。
AI.research_question: CEO社会网络对企业气候风险的保护作用及其边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 在全球气候治理深化和企业环境挑战加剧的背景下，将气候风险管理从被动合规提升到主动治理，研究其对可持续发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合高阶理论、制度理论和资源依赖理论，构建CEO社会网络影响企业气候风险的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用文本分析方法测量企业年报中的气候风险暴露程度，分析2015-2023年中国A股上市公司数据，进行内生性处理和敏感性测试。
AI.findings: CEO社会网络显著降低企业气候风险；碳排放强度正向调节该保护作用；CEO海外经验负向调节；区域环境规制强度正向调节；机制分析显示主要通过促进数字化转型实现风险缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统检验CEO社会网络的保护作用和多维边界，推进正式与非正式制度在环境治理中相互作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业构建气候韧性、投资者识别环境风险、监管者完善政策设计提供实践启示，对优化高管团队构成和平衡资本结构具有直接意义。

title: Bubble-Crash MSGARCH vs. MSGARCH: Forecasting Volatility and Backtesting Expected Shortfall in Bitcoin
affiliations: University of Naples Parthenope and

detail.title: Bubble-Crash MSGARCH vs. MSGARCH: Forecasting Volatility and Backtesting Expected Shortfall in Bitcoin

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Cryptocurrencies represent one of the most significant financial innovations of the twenty-first century. Their market has expanded rapidly, alongside growing integration into both institutional and retail investors' portfolios. Economic authorities and central banks have often warned investors about their high levels of volatility relative to traditional assets. Over the past decade, several episodes of financial bubbles and also price crashes have characterized the dynamics of this market. This paper contributes to the literature extending the Markov-Switching GARCH (MSGARCH) framework by explicitly accounting for bubble and flash crash dynamics in Bitcoin. In fact, after testing for the presence of periodically collapsing bubbles and flash crashes in Bitcoin price using the PSY test, it incorporates the identified episodes into the MSGARCH specification to improve the modeling of regime-dependent volatility. The resulting model is termed the Bubble-Crash MSGARCH (BC-MSGARCH), that is the variant of the BC-GARCH model applied to the MS-GARCH framework. The introduction of the Bubble-Crash filter substantially improves model specification, capturing nonlinear dynamics that a simple ARMA-based filter fails to represent. In addition, empirical evidence for Bitcoin shows that incorporating bubble and crash phases into the mean equation of an MSGARCH model significantly enhances volatility forecasting performance. Moreover, the model can also achieve better results in the backtesting of the Expected Shortfall.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了马尔可夫转换GARCH(MSGARCH)框架，通过显式考虑比特币的泡沫和闪崩动态，提出了Bubble-Crash MSGARCH(BC-MSGARCH)模型。该模型显著改善了波动率建模和预测性能，并在预期短缺的回测中表现更好。
AI.research_question: 如何改进MSGARCH模型以更好地捕捉比特币价格中的泡沫和闪崩动态？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场波动性极高，经常出现金融泡沫和价格崩盘，传统模型难以准确捕捉这些非线性动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫转换GARCH(MSGARCH)框架，结合泡沫和闪崩动态识别技术
AI.method: 使用PSY测试识别比特币价格中的泡沫和闪崩期，然后将这些识别出的时期纳入MSGARCH规范，构建BC-MSGARCH模型
AI.findings: Bubble-Crash滤波器的引入显著改善了模型设定，捕捉了ARMA基础滤波器无法表示的非线性动态；将泡沫和崩盘阶段纳入MSGARCH模型的均值方程显著提高了波动率预测性能
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了MSGARCH框架，提出了BC-MSGARCH模型，为加密货币波动率建模提供了新方法
AI.practical_contributions: 改进的波动率预测模型有助于投资者更好地管理加密货币投资风险，在预期短缺回测中表现更优

title: Asymptotic Optimality of Dynamic First-Fit Packing on the Half-Axis
affiliations: Imperial College London, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Industrial and Enterprise Systems Engineering and Imperial College London

detail.title: Asymptotic Optimality of Dynamic First-Fit Packing on the Half-Axis
detail.abstract: We revisit a classical problem in dynamic storage allocation. Items arrive in a linear storage medium, modeled as a half-axis, at a Poisson rate r and depart after an independent exponentially distributed unit mean service time. The arriving item sizes (lengths) are assumed to be independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) from a common distribution H. A widely employed algorithm for allocating the items is the "first-fit" discipline, namely, each arriving item is placed in the left-most vacant interval large enough to accommodate it. In a seminal 1985 paper, Coffman, Kadota, and Shepp [6] proved that in the special case of unit length items (i.e. degenerate H) the first-fit algorithm is asymptotically optimal in the following sense: the ratio of expected empty space to expected occupied space tends towards 0 as the occupied space tends towards infinity. In a sequel to [6], the authors of [5] conjectured that the first-fit discipline is also asymptotically optimal for non-degenerate H. In this paper we provide the first proofs of first-fit asymptotic optimality for non-degenerate distributions H. We begin with the case when items can be of sizes 1 and 2. We prove that under the first-fit discipline, as r → ∞, the steady-state packing configuration (scaled down by r) converges in distribution to the optimal limiting packing configuration, i.e. the one with smaller items on the left, larger items on the right, and with no gaps between. We then extend this result to the far more general case in which there are countably many item types with positive real sizes forming an increasing sequence that is either finite or goes to infinity, with the average item size being finite.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在动态存储分配问题中，当物品尺寸服从非退化分布时，首次适应算法是渐进最优的。首先处理了物品尺寸为1和2的情况，然后扩展到可数多种物品类型的一般情况。
AI.research_question: 在物品尺寸服从非退化分布的情况下，首次适应算法是否仍是渐进最优的存储分配策略？
AI.motivation: Coffman等人1985年证明了在单位长度物品情况下首次适应算法是渐进最优的，但其作者后续猜想该算法对非退化分布H也适用，本文旨在证明这一猜想。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态存储分配理论、排队论、渐进最优性分析、随机过程理论
AI.method: 使用概率分析和极限理论，首先证明物品尺寸为1和2的情况，然后扩展到可数多种物品类型的一般情况。通过证明稳态包装配置在缩放后收敛到最优极限包装配置。
AI.findings: 首次适应算法在物品尺寸服从非退化分布时确实是渐进最优的，稳态包装配置收敛到最优配置（小物品在左，大物品在右，无间隙）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明了首次适应算法对非退化分布H的渐进最优性，扩展了经典结果，为动态存储分配理论提供了重要理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际存储管理系统提供了理论依据，确认首次适应这一简单实用的算法在更广泛场景下的有效性，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Plaintiff Fees in Delaware Litigation: A Response to Mr. Hanrahan
affiliations: Stanford Law School and Stanford Law School

detail.title: Plaintiff Fees in Delaware Litigation: A Response to Mr. Hanrahan
detail.abstract:
Michael Hanrahan’s recent critique of our work traffics in ad hominem invective that does nothing to advance the analysis of Delaware fee awards. We look past Mr. Hanrahan’s unfortunate verbiage and focus on the merits of his critique. We demonstrate that even if one incorrectly accepts all of Mr. Hanrahan’s data-specific criticisms, septuples (fee awards with lodestar multipliers of seven or more) in Delaware remain far more frequent and extreme than in Federal court. Mr. Hanrahan misstates the law when he asserts “the lodestar method is inconsistent with Delaware law.” In response to anecdotal assertions of Delaware exceptionalism, we present the Enron fee award as a “counter-anecdote.” There, plaintiff firms achieved a $7.2 billion settlement, larger than any in Delaware history, in a matter that was arguably far more complex than any in Delaware history, for fees that generated a multiplier of 5.4 and a percentage of 9.52. These values are far lower than observed in many far less complex Delaware matters. Delaware’s Supreme Court recognizes that federal precedent is “didactic,” not controlling. What can Delaware learn from that federal precedent?

 

Delaware should not, however, address important questions relating to fee awards based on battling anecdotes. We therefore urge, as have others, that Delaware construct a transparent database that can inform this important policy debate in an unbiased and objective manner.

 

We agree with Mr. Hanrahan that the current fee setting process is flawed. Among many other concerns, it fails adequately to consider the time value of money and fails also to recognize real economic costs incurred by plaintiff firms when attempting to collect fees. To address those concerns, we briefly describe a forthcoming proposal by Professor Grundfest advocating a “holistic” fee approach in which courts are not forced to choose between percentage and lodestar methods. Instead, they would use both methods, supplemented with data describing stage-specific internal rates of return, and other key descriptive metrics. This holistic approach is designed to treat plaintiffs and counsel more fairly and to facilitate courts’ ability to satisfy their obligation to treat similar cases in a similar manner. Modern technology, combined with delegation to magistrates or special masters, and the introduction of carefully structured penalty functions, allows for efficient administration with little additional burden on sitting judges.

title: Market Culture: Competing for Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a

detail.abstract: This article examines the organizational culture type defined by an unrelenting focus on results, competition, and accountability. It explores how Market culture emerged from twentieth-century theories of strategic management, particularly those emphasizing efficiency, measurement, and competitive advantage. The article describes Market culture's characteristic emphasis on performance metrics, decisive leadership, and datadriven decision-making-traits that fuel organizational success in fast-moving, externally focused industries. It also analyzes the risks of imbalance when relentless pursuit of results erodes well-being, ethics, and collaboration. The discussion shows how Market culture can be strengthened through purpose alignment, ethical leadership, and sustainable performance systems and concludes with guidance on diagnosing and evolving Market culture to preserve its competitive edge while promoting resilience, humanity and long-term organizational health.
