title: Timeline Compression in Agricultural Value Capture: A Fast-Follower Framework for CoAee Processing Infrastructure Development
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Timeline Compression in Agricultural Value Capture: A Fast-Follower Framework for CoAee Processing Infrastructure Development
detail.abstract: Coffee-producing nations face a persistent structural asymmetry in global value capture, wherein non-producing consumer markets retain the majority of processing profits (UN Comtrade 2023). Switzerland exemplifies this phenomenon by generating a net value added surplus of $2.45 billion annually through coffee processing and re-export operations, despite producing no coffee domestically (UN Comtrade 2023). This value extraction occurs through control of three critical value chain stages: industrial processing infrastructure, proprietary brand development, and sophisticated distribution networks (European Coffee Federation 2024). Germany demonstrates similar dynamics, capturing $502.29 million in combined processing and logistics value through its position as the European Union's primary coffee trading hub (UN Comtrade 2023). Vietnam's development trajectory provides empirical evidence that producing nations can achieve functional upgrading in global value chains, having expanded production from 83,000 tonnes in 1990 to 1.8 million tonnes by 2024 while simultaneously developing domestic processing capacity and high-value export capabilities (ICO 2024; Oxford Academic 2024). However, this transition required 34 years of gradual institutional development, infrastructure investment, and market learning. This paper argues that coffee-producing nations initiating comprehensive value-capture strategies in 2025 can realistically compress Vietnam's 34-year timeline to approximately 6 years through strategic deployment of three critical accelerants: pre-validated global value chain models that eliminate exploratory policy development phases, turnkey processing infrastructure solutions that reduce capital expenditure timelines by 60%, and high-velocity blended finance structures including Development Finance Institutions and Impact Investing capital pools with $1.571 trillion in assets under management growing at 21% CAGR (Global Impact Investing Network 2024). The timeline compression framework demonstrates systematic reduction across five development phases. Planning and policy design compresses from 24-36 months to 6-9 months through immediate acquisition of consulting expertise and proven regulatory frameworks. Infrastructure development accelerates from 36-60 months to 18-24 months through deployment of turnkey processing solutions and modern capital markets. Expertise and quality control acquisition compresses from 36-48 months to 12-18 months via direct technology transfer and AI-enabled quality systems. Market entry and brand development accelerates from 60-120 months to 12-24 months through e-commerce platforms and established distribution partnerships. Sustained profitability timeline compresses from 7-10 years to 3-5 years through optimized capital structures and modern operational efficiency. This compressed development model presents a structured investment opportunity for private equity and development finance institutions. A $50-150 million blended finance facility targeting coffee processing infrastructure in producing nations could achieve internal rates of return between 12-18% while generating substantial development impact through value repatriation to origin economies. The 2025-2027 period represents an optimal intervention window coinciding with European Union Deforestation Regulation compliance requirements, historically elevated coffee prices, and mature availability of enabling technologies. The framework demonstrates that producing nations need not replicate Vietnam's protracted development timeline but can instead leverage pre-validated models and modern capital markets to achieve functional upgrading within a single investment fund lifecycle.

detail.abstract:
This dissertation establishes the first universal and reproducible framework for assessing sedimentation, scour, and internal erosion risk in hydroelectric dams, centered on the Yarlung Tsangpo’s Medog Hydropower Station. Developed as a companion to The Panama Canal Resilience Accord (PCRA) (SSRN: 5528140), it extends the same engineering and doctrinal philosophy from maritime chokepoints to high-relief hydropower systems. Whereas USACE manuals, ICOLD bulletins, and UNFC classifications treat these hazards in isolation, the Universal Framework integrates them into a single systems model using governing equations, probabilistic sensitivity analyses, and multi-horizon factor-of-safety (FoS) trajectories. It is transferable—any nation may substitute local parameters to generate reproducible outputs.

The model links delta growth, downstream scour, and foundation piping into one chain of structural degradation. Monte Carlo simulations show Medog’s FoS may fall from ≥1.5 at commissioning to ~1.2 within 20–25 years without mitigation. Comparative evidence from Three Gorges and Jinping II confirms this pattern mirrors observed degradation. Incorporating MycoGenesis® corridors and engineering reinforcements (grouting, drainage galleries, adaptive tailwater operations) extends service life by 5–10 years, reduces O&M and capital costs by $230–400 million, and lowers transboundary escalation risk by ~25%.

From an engineering standpoint, the Framework is the first integrated, probabilistic model uniting sedimentation, scour, and piping into a single predictive pathway. From a legal standpoint, it reframes these processes as foreseeable and quantifiable hazards, establishing constructive notice for operators and sponsoring states. Failure to mitigate thus invokes the duty of care under domestic negligence and international law, including the no-harm principle and Trail Smelter and Gabčíkovo–Nagymaros precedents. It thereby advances a doctrine of hydraulic foreseeability, merging engineering reproducibility, legal accountability, and adaptive governance into one enforceable standard of care.

The Framework’s dual contribution is clear: it refines systems design through the MycoGenesis® corridor stack—cutting sediment 15–25%, scour 20–25%, and raising FoS +0.03–0.12—while translating these verified reductions into treaty-grade compliance via transparent monitoring, consultation, and cooperative dividend-sharing. Dam safety thus evolves from a technical discipline to a juridical instrument of global hydrodiplomacy.

The accompanying Dam Safety Telemetry System (DSTS) operationalizes the Framework through the Any Nation Protocol (ANP). Built in modular layers (edge, core, audit, GIS, econ, UI, DevOps), DSTS guarantees deterministic data ingestion, evidentiary continuity, and cross-sovereign interoperability. Aligned with MIT reproducibility standards and Harvard Law foreseeability doctrine, it stands as the canonical computational reference for international deployment, verification, and treaty enforcement under the Doctrine of Verification.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文建立了首个评估水电站大坝沉积、冲刷和内部侵蚀风险的通用可复现框架，以雅鲁藏布江墨脱水电站为中心。该框架将三种风险整合到单一系统模型中，使用蒙特卡洛模拟预测安全系数下降趋势，并提出MycoGenesis®走廊等工程加固措施可延长使用寿命5-10年，降低运维成本2.3-4亿美元。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个通用且可复现的框架来评估水电站大坝的沉积、冲刷和内部侵蚀风险？
AI.motivation: 现有USACE手册、ICOLD公报和UNFC分类将这些风险孤立处理，缺乏集成方法。需要从海事瓶颈工程扩展到高落差水电站系统的统一风险评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水力可预见性理论，结合工程可复现性、法律问责制和适应性治理，建立可执行的责任标准。
AI.method: 使用控制方程、概率敏感性分析和多时间尺度安全系数轨迹的集成系统模型，通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行风险评估。
AI.findings: 墨脱水电站安全系数可能在20-25年内从≥1.5降至约1.2；采用MycoGenesis®走廊等工程措施可减少沉积15-25%、冲刷20-25%，提高安全系数0.03-0.12。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了首个将沉积、冲刷和管涌整合到单一预测路径的集成概率模型；提出了水力可预见性理论，将工程风险转化为可量化的法律义务。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可转移的通用框架，任何国家都可替换本地参数；通过工程措施延长使用寿命5-10年，降低运维成本2.3-4亿美元；建立了大坝安全遥测系统(DSTS)实现跨国互操作性。

detail.abstract:
This journal is based on an article discussing recent developments in Argentina, highlighting the prolonged summer season caused by the El Niño phenomenon. The issue reflects broader environmental challenges that many countries in South America currently face as climate variability intensifies. Argentina’s unusually long summer has led to significant economic and ecological impacts, particularly in agriculture, energy consumption, and water resources.

The main focus of this study is on sustainability and the country’s capacity to maintain long-term resilience amid climatic disturbances. It examines how Argentina adapts to these conditions through environmental management, sustainable resource use, and the development of climate-resilient policies. By analyzing this case, the journal aims to provide insights into how developing nations can strengthen their sustainability strategies in the face of recurring climate anomalies such as El Niño.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了厄尔尼诺现象导致阿根廷夏季延长带来的经济和生态影响，重点研究该国在气候变化下的可持续性和长期韧性，探讨如何通过环境管理、资源可持续利用和气候韧性政策来适应这些条件。

title: Three Worlds   - Capitalizam, Virtualizm, Sharerizm

detail.title: Three Worlds   - Capitalizam, Virtualizm, Sharerizm
detail.abstract:
“Three Worlds” explains the complex problems facing modern society and three distinct worldviews addressing them—capitalist society (Capitalism), virtual reality society (Virtualism), and republican society (Shareism).

The introduction touches on questions and problems unique to modern society, such as the phenomenon of IT billionaires acquiring vast wealth overnight, the low wages of childcare workers and nursing care workers, society's anxiety and distrust toward the metaverse, Web 3.0, and NFTs, discomfort with government-promoted urban planning and regional revitalization, Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter, the spread of smartphones, and the pros and cons of holding Diet sessions in person.

Against the backdrop of these issues, the book views the phenomenon of society rapidly and complexly differentiating itself as “three worlds” and explains in detail how each world is constructed and how it functions. Specifically, these are “Capitalism,” driven by capital; “Virtualism,” where data races across networks; and “Shareism,” where people cooperate and live in harmony with nature, rooted in their communities.

Each worldview possess its own distinct concepts, institutions, and economic systems, which the book explains in separate chapters. It also examines how these three worlds intersect within modern society and influence people's lives and values.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了现代社会的复杂问题，提出了三种不同的世界观：资本主义、虚拟主义和共享主义，并探讨了它们各自的概念、制度和经济体系，以及这些世界观如何相互交织影响人们的生活和价值观。
AI.research_question: 现代社会中存在的复杂问题如何通过三种不同的世界观（资本主义、虚拟主义和共享主义）来解释和解决？
AI.motivation: 现代社会中出现的各种现象，如IT富豪一夜暴富、护理人员低工资、对元宇宙和Web 3.0的不信任、政府规划引发的不适等，需要新的理论框架来理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三种世界观的理论框架：资本主义（资本驱动）、虚拟主义（数据在网络中流动）、共享主义（人与自然和谐共处、社区为基础）。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，通过详细解释每种世界观的概念、制度和经济系统来展开分析。
AI.findings: 现代社会正在快速分化为三个不同的世界，每个世界都有其独特的运行逻辑和价值观，这些世界在现实中相互交织并影响人们的生活。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"三个世界"的理论框架，为理解现代社会的复杂性提供了新的分析视角，丰富了社会理论的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助读者理解现代社会的多元性，为政策制定者、企业家和个人在面对不同世界观时提供决策参考。

title: A Cross-Country Study of Preferences for Choice Autonomy
affiliations: Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts and University of Fribourg - Department of Economics

detail.title: A Cross-Country Study of Preferences for Choice Autonomy

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We establish the existence of intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy, defined as a preference for own choice in the absence of any instrumental value of choice, in large general population samples in nine countries using a novel preference elicitation tool. We find that such preferences are widespread, but also reveal stark differences across countries. Within countries, individuals who place a higher value on self-reliance and personal identity exhibit stronger intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy. In our small cross-country sample, we find suggestive evidence that differences are correlated with power distance, but not with measures of individualism, and that differences are predictive of managerial decentralization across countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究在九个国家的普通人群中发现普遍存在对选择自主权的内在偏好，这种偏好与自我依赖和个人身份认同相关，且跨国差异与权力距离相关，并能预测管理分权程度。

AI.theoretical_framework: 选择自主权理论、文化维度理论（权力距离、个人主义）、管理分权理论
AI.method: 使用新颖的偏好诱导工具，在九个国家的普通人群中进行大规模调查
AI.findings: 1) 内在选择自主权偏好普遍存在；2) 存在显著的跨国差异；3) 重视自我依赖和个人身份认同的个体偏好更强；4) 跨国差异与权力距离相关，与个人主义无关；5) 偏好差异能预测管理分权程度
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模跨国样本中证实内在选择自主权偏好的存在，建立了偏好与文化维度、管理实践的联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业的管理分权决策提供依据，帮助理解不同文化背景下员工对自主权的需求差异

title: The Impact of Trade on Emissions Responses to Renewable Supply Variation
affiliations: and Colorado School of Mines - Division of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Impact of Trade on Emissions Responses to Renewable Supply Variation
detail.abstract: Reducing barriers to trade-one approach to facilitate the integration of renewables on the electricity grid-affects emissions externalities by altering which fossil fuel power plants generate and emit criteria pollutants. We use the Western Energy Imbalance Market as a case study to quantify how plants change their emissions response to wind and solar generation variability after a market expansion. We find that, on average, plant responses shrink after entering the market. The average plant response, while still negative, becomes less so, as it becomes easier for a region to import or export electricity to balance local renewable variability. Specifically, responses to solar increase by between 0.80 to 1.85 percent and responses to wind increase by between 0.01 to 0.02 percent. This effect is larger for plants in regions without a pre-existing market mechanism prior to entry. While all participants gain an increased diversity and quantity of supply and demand sources, plants without prior market access also benefit from the move to a more efficient method of trade.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电力市场整合如何通过改变化石燃料发电厂的排放响应来影响可再生能源并网。研究发现，加入西部能源不平衡市场后，电厂对风能和太阳能发电波动的排放响应平均减少，特别是那些之前没有市场机制的地区的电厂受益更多。
AI.research_question: 电力市场整合如何影响化石燃料发电厂对风能和太阳能发电波动的排放响应？
AI.motivation: 减少贸易壁垒是促进可再生能源在电网中整合的一种方法，但会通过改变哪些化石燃料发电厂发电和排放标准污染物来影响排放外部性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力市场整合理论、排放外部性理论、可再生能源并网经济学
AI.method: 使用西部能源不平衡市场作为案例研究，量化市场扩张后电厂如何改变对风能和太阳能发电波动的排放响应。
AI.findings: 进入市场后，电厂的平均排放响应缩小；对太阳能的响应增加0.80-1.85%，对风能的响应增加0.01-0.02%；之前没有市场机制的地区电厂效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对电力市场整合如何通过改变发电调度模式影响排放响应的理解，为可再生能源并网政策提供了理论支持。

reference: INSEAD Working Paper No. 2025/51/TOM/DSC
title: AI and Corporate Governance: An Opportunity to Get It Right
affiliations: INSEAD, INSEAD, INSEAD - Technology and Operations Management and INSEAD - Technology and Operations Management

detail.title: AI and Corporate Governance: An Opportunity to Get It Right

publicationDetails.journalName: INSEAD Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The debate on artificial intelligence (AI) has largely focused on its transformative effects on organizations, management practices, and global power dynamics. Far less attention has been given to its implications for corporate governance and the functioning of boards beyond the now-familiar call for directors to become "AI literate" and for boards to benefit from "AI Assistance." We argue that AI's impact may be far deeper and more constructive. Rather than rendering boards obsolete, AI could finally enable them to fulfil their intended fiduciary role: exercising informed, independent, and accountable responsibility and oversight of the corporation. To support this claim, we review the enduring challenges to board effectiveness-spanning information, time, action, emotion, and spirit-and explore how AI can help address each. By narrowing information asymmetries, expanding attention between meetings, improving foresight, moderating group dynamics, and preserving institutional purpose, AI may usher in what we call a right-setting of corporate governance-perhaps even a long-awaited golden age of responsible and greatly more effective boards.

AI.tldr: 本文认为AI对董事会治理的影响比现有讨论更深远，AI不仅能帮助董事会履行其受托责任，还能解决董事会面临的信息、时间、行动、情感和精神等五大挑战，可能带来公司治理的"黄金时代"。

title: Welfare Bounds for Linear-quadratic Network Games
affiliations: and Department of Economics, Kobe University

detail.title: Welfare Bounds for Linear-quadratic Network Games
detail.abstract: This paper quantifies the efficiency of the Nash equilibrium in the class of linear-quadratic network games. We show that the theoretical bounds of the welfare ratio, defined as the equilibrium welfare relative to the social optimum, are fully characterized by the spectrum of the adjacency matrix of the underlying network. Specifically, the lower bound of the welfare ratio is determined by the largest eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix, while the upper bound reaches unity whenever the matrix is rank-deficient. Applying the theory to empirical social networks, we find that the upper bounds tend to be close to unity.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了线性二次网络博弈中纳什均衡的效率，发现福利比的理论边界完全由网络邻接矩阵的谱特征决定，下界取决于最大特征值，上界在矩阵秩亏损时达到1。实证分析显示社交网络中的上界通常接近1。
AI.research_question: 线性二次网络博弈中纳什均衡的效率边界如何由网络结构决定？
AI.motivation: 理解网络结构如何影响博弈均衡效率，为网络设计提供理论指导
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性二次网络博弈理论、纳什均衡、社会福利优化
AI.method: 理论推导福利比边界与邻接矩阵谱特征的关系，并应用于实证社交网络分析
AI.findings: 福利比下界由邻接矩阵最大特征值决定，上界在矩阵秩亏损时达到1；实证网络中上界通常接近1
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了网络博弈效率与网络谱特征的精确理论关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络设计者提供了评估和优化网络效率的理论工具

title: Using AI in Scenario Planning: Letting it Rip or Doing The Right Thing?
affiliations: Narxoz University

detail.title: Using AI in Scenario Planning: Letting it Rip or Doing The Right Thing?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Grey Swan / Archimedes, a governed, AI-assisted foresight method that produces quarterly, evidence-linked probabilities for two postures: Do The Right Thing and Let It Rip. Public indicators drive bounded moves under persistence, corroboration, diffusion, and symmetric reversion. Evidence tiers: a canon (Tier 0), slow anchors (Tier 1), a frozen set of signals refreshed each run (Tier 2), and a context layer that does not move odds (Tier 3). Levers span energy, health, education, trust, coordination, and compute, with climate treated cross-cutting. Results are global. The architecture scales to sectors and countries and iterates. The forecasts are sobering.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为Grey Swan/Archimedes的受治理、AI辅助的预见方法，该方法为"做正确的事"和"放任自流"两种姿态生成季度性、证据关联的概率预测。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种受治理的AI辅助预见方法，为全球战略决策提供证据关联的概率预测？
AI.motivation: 需要一种系统化的方法来预测全球发展趋势，为政策制定者提供基于证据的战略决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于持续性、确证性、扩散性和对称回归等原则的公共指标驱动框架。
AI.method: 采用四级证据层级：经典文献（0级）、慢速锚点（1级）、定期更新的信号集（2级）和不影响概率的上下文层（3级）。
AI.findings: 预测结果令人警醒，该方法可扩展到部门和国家级别并迭代更新。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可扩展的、受治理的AI辅助预见方法架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球决策者提供了基于证据的概率预测工具，涵盖能源、健康、教育、信任、协调和计算等关键领域。

title: Who Builds, Who Owns, Who Benefits? Modeling Global Disparities in AI Capability and Control
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Who Builds, Who Owns, Who Benefits? Modeling Global Disparities in AI Capability and Control
detail.abstract: Drawing on foundational development economics models we examine how value is produced and captured across the global AI value stream to explain persistent and widening inequalities. The findings reveal that only a handful of countries dominate high-value functions, while many others are trapped in extractive, low-IP roles such as annotation and moderation despite contributing essential inputs to AI model development. We argue that the current AI ecosystem is entrenching a two-speed global economy: one characterized by capital accumulation and IP concentration, and another by invisible labor and technological dependency. The paper concludes with recommendations for compute equity, urban ecosystem investment, and global governance mechanisms to mitigate these disparities. By reframing AI development as a political-economic process, the study offers a new lens for assessing technological globalization and strategic power.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于发展经济学模型分析全球AI价值链中的价值生产和分配，揭示了少数国家主导高价值功能而多数国家被困在低价值角色的不平等现象，提出了计算公平、城市生态系统投资和全球治理机制等政策建议。

AI.motivation: 当前AI生态系统正在加剧全球经济发展的不平衡，少数国家主导高价值功能，而许多其他国家尽管为AI模型开发提供了必要投入，却被困在低知识产权的角色中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础发展经济学模型，政治经济学视角
AI.method: 基于发展经济学模型的分析框架，考察全球AI价值流
AI.findings: 研究发现只有少数国家主导高价值功能，而许多其他国家被困在标注和审核等低知识产权角色中，形成了资本积累和知识产权集中与技术依赖和隐形劳动并存的二元全球经济。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将AI发展重新构建为政治经济过程，为评估技术全球化和战略权力提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了计算公平、城市生态系统投资和全球治理机制等具体政策建议，以缓解AI发展中的不平等问题。

title: Marx's Sausage Factory and Marx's Road: Education and the General Class of Commodities
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Marx's Sausage Factory and Marx's Road: Education and the General Class of Commodities
detail.abstract: This paper complements the presentation I gave at HM London Conference 2024 where the focus was on labour-power and its social re/production. Labour-power is the unique commodity, the ‘class of one’; the only commodity that has the capacity to generate more value – surplus-value – than what it takes to reproduce itself when it is transformed into labour in capitalist labour processes. For this 2025 presentation, the focus is on the general class of commodities; that is, all commodities excluding labour-power. In particular, educational commodification and value production in educational institutions are explored. Can education be a commodity? Is education productive of value? If education is a commodity why does it matter? These perennial questions regarding educational commodification, questions that bedevil mainstream sociology and liberal thought as much as Marxist educational theory, are at the centre of this presentation. The first section of the paper lays the ground by drawing from Marx’s ideas on the commodity and value production. It also presents some of the hand-wringing statements and nebulous arguments regarding whether education can be a commodity, or not. Section two visits Marx’s metaphor of education as a ‘sausage factory’ in Capital. It indicates how, under certain conditions, what goes on in educational institutions results in commodity and value-production. The third section focuses on ‘Marx’s road’; his discussion on the roles of State, Money and ‘capital as capital’ in the production of value in Notebook V from the Grundrisse. The conclusions from this section are then dragged back to the ‘sausage factory’ to give a fuller account of educational commodification and value production. The Conclusion revisits questions of whether education is, or can be, a commodity, if it produces value, and why such questions are important. This last point draws on the work of Mike Neary.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨教育商品化问题，基于马克思的商品和价值生产理论，分析教育是否能够成为商品以及是否产生价值。
AI.research_question: 教育能否成为商品？教育是否产生价值？教育作为商品为何重要？
AI.motivation: 解决关于教育商品化的长期争议，这些争议困扰着主流社会学、自由主义思想和马克思主义教育理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思的商品理论、价值生产理论、教育作为'香肠工厂'的隐喻、国家、货币和资本在价值生产中的作用
AI.method: 理论分析，基于马克思《资本论》和《大纲》中的相关论述，结合对教育商品化问题的批判性讨论
AI.findings: 在特定条件下，教育机构中的活动确实会导致商品和价值生产；国家、货币和资本在教育价值生产中发挥重要作用
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对教育商品化和价值生产的马克思主义理解，澄清了教育作为商品的本质
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代教育商品化现象提供理论框架，揭示了教育在资本主义生产体系中的特殊地位

title: When the Island Grows Sick: Civilization, Myth, and the Return of Meaning in Moana
affiliations: Independent Researcher, South Korea

detail.title: When the Island Grows Sick: Civilization, Myth, and the Return of Meaning in Moana
detail.abstract: Disney’s Moana uses mythic storytelling to explore the loss and recovery of meaning in a society. The island of Motunui, once vibrant, succumbs to a mysterious blight – a metaphor for a civilization that has lost its soul. This essay argues that Moana’s voyage is not mere escape but a cyclical return to origin, through which meaning is restored. Drawing on Heidegger’s notions of authenticity and Gelassenheit (releasement) , Nietzsche’s eternal recurrence and becoming , Campbell’s hero’s journey , and Eliade’s sacred time , we show how the heroine emerges as a voyager who revives cultural life. The stolen heart of the goddess Te Fiti symbolizes a severed soul of civilization, and its return is a ritual re-sanctification of the world. Departure, return, and new departure form a rhythmic pulse (as with the ocean’s waves) – the necessary cycle of any living society. Contemporary theorists like Byung-Chul Han warn of our “excessive positivity” culture and loss of rhythm, issues that Moana’s myth implicitly addresses. Finally, we consider Moana 2 as a continuation of this mythic rhythm: once again a call to adventure emerges, ensuring the cycle endures. The essay concludes that Moana proposes a philosophical affirmation: societal illness can seed new voyages of meaning – the wave that remains, beckoning the next voyager.

AI.tldr: 《海洋奇缘》通过神话叙事探讨社会意义的丧失与恢复，分析莫阿娜的旅程如何通过回归起源来恢复文化意义，借鉴海德格尔、尼采、坎贝尔和伊利亚德的理论框架。
AI.research_question: 《海洋奇缘》中的神话叙事如何体现社会意义的丧失与恢复过程？

detail.title: Credit Risk Assessment in Pakistani SMES: Challenges and AI Solutions
detail.abstract: This paper explores the challenges encountered by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Pakistan in obtaining credit. It investigates how artificial intelligence (AI)-driven solutions can enhance access to financing for SMEs by offering lending institutions protection from potential losses due to defaulters. The findings underscore the importance of integrating technological innovation with policy measures to bridge the SME financing gap and promote sustainable economic growth.

title: Dynamics of Sovereign Debt: Credit Risk and Sustainability Analysis
affiliations: and University of Oxford

detail.title: Dynamics of Sovereign Debt: Credit Risk and Sustainability Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: Karolina Bassa's research has been funded through ESPRC Grant EP/S023925/1 and the European Union's Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation under the Marie Curie-Sklodowska Grant 870245.

detail.abstract: We propose an empirically grounded quantitative framework for modeling sovereign credit risk and evaluating the sustainability of sovereign debt. We study the impact of fiscal and public investment policies on the sovereign's borrowing cost and credit risk in the presence of stochastic output shocks and credit-sensitive funding from investors, with a focus on the dynamics of liquidity flows and the sustainability of sovereign debt. The model is able to replicate a range of empirical observations on sovereign credit risk and sovereign defaults, in particular Argentina's 2001 default and Greece's 2012 debt restructuring events, with realistic dynamics for debt, spreads and credit ratings conditional on output. The framework is useful for debt sustainability analysis and to estimate the impact of fiscal policy on debt and output. Finally, we propose a transparent methodology for sovereign credit ratings based on this approach.

title: Ecolabels Promote Sustainable Production Behavior in a Common Resource Dilemma
affiliations: University of Amsterdam, University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam School of Economics and University of Amsterdam - Faculty of Economics and Business (FEB)

detail.title: Ecolabels Promote Sustainable Production Behavior in a Common Resource Dilemma

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained for all procedures from the Economics and Business Ethics Committee (EBEC) at the University of Amsterdam.

detail.abstract: Mitigating climate change requires urgent shifts toward sustainable consumption and production. While ecolabels have been widely studied as cost-effective tools for influencing consumer behavior, their effects on producers remain largely unexplored. We test the effect of ecolabels on sustainable production behavior in a dynamic common-pool resource dilemma with real economic and environmental incentives. In our lab experiment, groups of participants trade off short-term individual profits from resource extraction against long-term group-level gains and resource preservation. We find that ecolabels significantly increase sustainable production and extend resource longevity, improving both long-term environmental and economic outcomes. They facilitate early coordination on sustainable behavior which is then maintained through conditional cooperation. Importantly, these effects arise even when ecolabels are purely symbolic and provide no monetary benefit. Our findings uncover underexplored producer-side mechanisms of ecolabels and suggest that, beyond consumer nudges, ecolabels can serve as powerful policy instruments for promoting sustainable production.

AI.tldr: 生态标签能显著提高生产者的可持续生产行为，延长资源寿命，改善长期环境和经济结果，即使生态标签只是象征性的且不提供货币利益。

title: Sailing Through Climate Shocks: How Temperatures Changes Disrupt Maritime Trade
affiliations: , Cyprus University of Technology and

detail.title: Sailing Through Climate Shocks: How Temperatures Changes Disrupt Maritime Trade
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of global temperature variations on freight markets and marine trade. We investigate the short-and long-term correlations between global temperature, seaborne trade volumes, freight rates, oil prices, and fleet capacity using quarterly data from 1996Q1-2023Q3 using a Vector Error Correction Model (VECM). The findings show a strong inverse relationship between rising temperatures and international trade volumes, indicating that heat shocks lower energy demand and export activity. As a result, the price of Brent oil drops, which in turn drives down freight rates. The results also demonstrate that the total effect of temperature on shipping markets is transmitted through demand-side processes, even while fleet capacity is essentially unaffected. Dry bulk trade is especially vulnerable to temperature rises, which results in decreased freight earnings in this segment, according to robustness checks using the Baltic Dry Index. These findings demonstrate how temperature shocks brought on by climate change might alter the dynamics of marine markets and interfere with international trade flows. The ramifications are twofold: first, rising temperatures could jeopardize the stability and profitability of the shipping sector; second, they might potentially help reduce inflationary pressures by lowering transportation costs. For policymakers and business stakeholders navigating a warming world, our work offers the first empirical data connecting temperature changes to the success of international marine trade.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过VECM模型分析发现全球温度升高与国际贸易量呈负相关关系，温度冲击通过降低能源需求和出口活动影响海运市场，特别是干散货贸易对温度上升最为敏感。
AI.research_question: 全球温度变化对货运市场和海洋贸易的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解气候变化引起的温度冲击如何改变海运市场动态并干扰国际贸易流动，为政策制定者和行业利益相关者提供实证数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于需求侧传导机制理论，温度变化通过影响能源需求和出口活动来影响海运市场。
AI.method: 使用1996Q1-2023Q3的季度数据，采用向量误差修正模型(VECM)分析全球温度、海运贸易量、运费率、油价和船队容量之间的短期和长期相关性。
AI.findings: 温度上升与国际海运贸易量呈强负相关；热冲击降低能源需求和出口活动；布伦特油价下降进而压低运费率；船队容量基本不受影响；干散货贸易对温度上升特别敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供温度变化与国际海运贸易成功之间联系的实证数据，揭示了温度冲击通过需求侧过程影响海运市场的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业利益相关者提供在变暖世界中导航的指导：温度上升可能危及航运业稳定性和盈利能力，同时可能通过降低运输成本帮助缓解通胀压力。

title:
Coinjoins are Isomorphic to Zero-Knowledge Mixers

With Applications to the Consistency of Blockchain-based Obfucastion Service Regulation
affiliations: ChainArgos

detail.title:
Coinjoins are Isomorphic to Zero-Knowledge Mixers

With Applications to the Consistency of Blockchain-based Obfucastion Service Regulation
detail.abstract: Coinjoins and zero-knowledge (zk) mixers are the dominant source-of-funds-obfuscation tools on UTXO and account-model blockchains respectively. Here we provide an isomorphism between the two techniques. This straightforward mapping has broad implications for the regulation of obfuscation services. For, if coinjoins and zk mixers are mathematically equivalent, it is essential to ensure that functionally-identical products are treated equally under the law independent of what legal standards one chooses. Not only is differential treatment of differently-presented-but-fundamentallyidentical technologies manifestly unfair-it is likely a violation of basic legal protections and principles across a wide range of jurisdictions. This isomorphism also expands the space of test data for both service types by allowing practitioners to convert easily between them when evaluating accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立Coinjoins和零知识混币器之间的同构映射，论证了这两种资金混淆技术在数学上的等价性，并指出这种等价性对监管公平性和技术测试具有重要意义。
AI.research_question: Coinjoins和零知识混币器之间是否存在数学上的等价关系？这种等价关系对监管和技术测试有何影响？
AI.motivation: 当前UTXO和账户模型区块链分别使用Coinjoins和零知识混币器作为主要的资金来源混淆工具，但两者在监管和技术评估中可能受到不同对待。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同构理论，建立Coinjoins和零知识混币器之间的数学映射关系。
AI.method: 理论分析和数学映射构建方法。
AI.findings: 发现Coinjoins和零知识混币器之间存在直接的同构映射关系，两者在数学上是等价的。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了Coinjoins和零知识混币器之间的同构理论框架，为理解两种技术的本质关系提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供了技术等价性的理论依据，要求对功能相同但表现形式不同的技术给予平等对待；2) 扩展了两种技术的测试数据空间，允许从业者在评估准确性时进行相互转换。

title: The New Gold Standard: Financialization, Geopolitics, and the Structural Revaluation of a Precious Metal
affiliations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology

detail.title: The New Gold Standard: Financialization, Geopolitics, and the Structural Revaluation of a Precious Metal
detail.abstract: The 2024-2025 surge in gold prices, surpassing US$4,100 per ounce with gains of nearly 100%, represents a puzzle that challenges conventional economic explanations. This paper argues that traditional drivers like in lation and interest rates are secondary to two transformative structural forces. First, the inancialization of gold via Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) has democratized access, amplifying investment lows and creating powerful feedback loops driven by momentum and the "fear of missing out." Second, and more critically, gold is being weaponized geopolitically. Central banks in emerging markets, notably China and Russia, are engaging in strategic de-dollarization, accumulating gold as a sanctions-proof reserve asset. This price-inelastic demand, rooted in geopolitical strategy rather than pro it motive, creates a persistent and resilient foundation for higher prices. Analyzing these drivers through a systematic literature review and a contemporary case study, this paper concludes that the gold rally is not a cyclical anomaly but a structural revaluation. It signals a broader fragmentation of the global inancial order, with profound implications for international policy, investment strategy, and commodity-exporting nations.

AI.tldr: 2024-2025年黄金价格飙升至每盎司4100美元以上，涨幅近100%，这一现象挑战了传统经济解释。论文认为，传统驱动因素如通胀和利率是次要的，而两个结构性力量更为关键：一是黄金通过ETF的金融化，二是黄金被地缘政治武器化。
AI.research_question: 是什么结构性力量驱动了2024-2025年黄金价格的异常飙升？
AI.motivation: 传统经济理论无法充分解释黄金价格近100%的异常涨幅，需要探索新的结构性驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融化理论、地缘政治经济学、去美元化理论、价格非弹性需求理论
AI.method: 系统文献综述和当代案例研究
AI.findings: 黄金价格飙升主要由两个结构性力量驱动：1）通过ETF的金融化放大投资流动和反馈循环；2）新兴市场央行的战略性去美元化，将黄金作为制裁免疫的储备资产
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了黄金价格的结构性重估理论，强调地缘政治因素在商品定价中的核心作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际政策制定、投资策略和商品出口国提供了重要启示，揭示了全球金融秩序碎片化的趋势

detail.title: Cognitive Capitalism and the Task Frontier: Macroeconomic Reorganization in the Age of Artificial Intelligence. A Structured Synthesis on How Artificial Intelligence Redefines Capital, Labor, and Productivity in the 21st Century
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is not just another technology; it is a redefinition of the economic production function itself. Building on Acemoglu's "The Simple Macroeconomics of AI" (1), this paper examines how machine cognition is transforming labor, capital, and institutional behavior across global economies. Using recent evidence from arXiv, the NBER, the GAO, and peerreviewed literature (2-9), it explores how AI is reshaping productivity, wage distribution, and the structure of finance. The results suggest an era of cognitive capitalism, where value no longer depends on physical assets or even human time but on how effectively humans and algorithms co-create new tasks.

title: Volatility Forecasting in Financial Time-Series: A Comparative Study of GARCH, XGBoost, and LSTM Models
affiliations: , Columbia University, Columbia University, Columbia University and Columbia University

detail.title: Volatility Forecasting in Financial Time-Series: A Comparative Study of GARCH, XGBoost, and LSTM Models
detail.abstract: Forecasting market volatility is essential for pricing derivatives, managing risk, and designing trading strategies. This study compares traditional econometric and modern machine learning approaches to model S&P 500 volatility over the period 2018-2024, a period that includes several highstress market regimes such as the COVID-19 pandemic. We evaluated a conventional GARCH(1,1) model against two datadriven architectures: XGBoost, a gradient-boosted ensemble method, and LSTM, a recurrent neural network capable of capturing temporal dependencies. All models are trained in rolling windows of daily returns derived from the price data of S&P 500 and evaluated using R^2 , RMSE, and MAPE. Our results show that both deep learning models substantially outperform GARCH, with the LSTM achieving the strongest out-of-sample performance (R^2 = 0.962) and the lowest prediction error (MAPE = 0.066). These findings highlight the capacity of nonlinear sequence and ensemble methods to capture volatility clustering and structural regime shifts that traditional models fail to represent. We conclude that hybrid frameworks combining econometric interpretability with machine learning flexibility offer a promising direction for robust volatility forecasting in dynamic markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了传统计量经济学模型(GARCH)与现代机器学习方法(XGBoost、LSTM)在预测S&P 500波动率方面的表现，发现深度学习模型显著优于传统模型，LSTM表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 传统计量经济学模型与现代机器学习方法在预测市场波动率方面的表现比较如何？
AI.motivation: 准确预测市场波动率对于衍生品定价、风险管理和交易策略设计至关重要，特别是在包含COVID-19疫情等高压市场环境的时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率预测理论、时间序列分析、机器学习理论
AI.method: 使用GARCH(1,1)模型与XGBoost、LSTM两种机器学习方法进行对比，基于2018-2024年S&P 500日收益率数据，采用滚动窗口训练，使用R²、RMSE和MAPE评估模型性能。
AI.findings: 深度学习模型显著优于GARCH模型，LSTM获得最强的样本外表现(R²=0.962)和最低预测误差(MAPE=0.066)。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了非线性序列和集成方法能够捕捉传统模型无法表示的波动率聚类和结构性制度转换。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出结合计量经济学可解释性和机器学习灵活性的混合框架，为动态市场中的稳健波动率预测提供了有前景的方向。

detail.abstract: This article employs a combined framework of political realism, critical discourse analysis, and comparative historical study to examine the phenomenon of the "Genocide of Freedom"-the systematic suppression, particularly in the American academy post-October 2023, of critical discourse regarding Israel. Its central argument is that the mechanism of "Sacred Ignorance" (which operates primarily through the labeling of critics as anti-Semitic and the apocalyptic sacralization of Israel) is not merely an ideological conflict, but a realist tool for perpetuating costly policies and consolidating the hegemony of a network of interest groups. By tracing analogous historical patterns, from the Inquisition to modern totalitarian regimes, the article demonstrates how the structural confrontation between critical discourse (science/rationality) and dogmatic discourse (sacred ignorance) has led to the "Genocide of Freedom." In response, the article formulates the call for a "Sacred Rebellion"-as a rational resistance against sanctified ideologies-within the framework of the "The Second Enlightenment" project, considering it both a moral imperative and a realist strategy for reclaiming rationality from the clutches of the powerideology coalition.

detail.abstract: This study examines the role of behavioral biases-such as overconfidence, loss aversion, herding, and anchoring-in shaping stock market investment decisions. Using a mixedmethod approach, primary survey data is combined with secondary market datasets to capture the psychological and financial aspects of investor behavior. A Machine Learning model is developed to detect and predict the presence of biases in investment decision-making patterns. The proposed system aims to provide actionable insights to retail investors, financial advisors, and policymakers to improve decision-making efficiency and minimize risk. Results are expected to contribute to behavioral finance literature while introducing a technological framework for bias detection.

detail.title: A Threshold For Commitment Scarcity in a Two-Contract Sexual Matching Market
detail.abstract: We study a sexual matching market with two contract types: unilaterally terminable and non-terminable. Coasean transfers allow agents to implement strong commitments within the terminable market. Exogenous shocks that lower exit costs reduce commitment through equilibrium selection, even when matchers prefer more commitment.

title: An Analysis of Economic Impact of the UAE-India CEPA On Bilateral Trade: A Data Driven Study Over the Years

detail.title: An Analysis of Economic Impact of the UAE-India CEPA On Bilateral Trade: A Data Driven Study Over the Years
detail.abstract: India and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) share a deep-rooted partnership built on trade, energy, diaspora, and strategic cooperation. The UAE is India’s thirdlargest trading partner after United States and China, and a major energy supplier, while India exports gems, textiles, machinery, and food products. The 2022 Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) was signed with an ambition to further elevate bilateral trade by reducing tariffs and expanding market access. The UAE hosts over 3.5 million Indians, contributing to its economy and remitting significantly to India. Together, both nations drive regional cooperation in trade, energy, and innovation. This study investigates the impact CEPA between the UAE and India on bilateral trade. This partnership agreement is India’s first bilateral trade pact in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region and the CEPA extends beyond goods to include services, investments, and broader areas of economic cooperation. This study however predominantly investigates Merchandise Trade between the UAE and India over the years. Drawing on multiple data sources— including Ministry of Commerce, Government of India, trade statistics and news items, the analysis compares trade patterns between the two countries before and after the agreement’s implementation. Findings indicate that the CEPA has significantly deepened bilateral trade particularly in sectors such as mineral fuels, precious and semi-precious stones, gems and jewellery, clothes, mechanical appliances, aircraft and parts thereof, floating structures and more.

title: The Power of Autonomy: Self-Selected Goals Outperform Assigned Goals in Reducing Mobile Phone Usage
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Udaipur, INSEAD, Fundación Instituto de Empresa, S.L. - IE Business School and Indian School of Business

detail.title: The Power of Autonomy: Self-Selected Goals Outperform Assigned Goals in Reducing Mobile Phone Usage
detail.abstract: Behavior change interventions often involve experimenter-assigned goals. We test whether granting individuals autonomy in goal-setting enhances motivation and behavioral change when average goal difficulty and incentives are held constant. In an eleven-week randomized field experiment (N = 149), participants were assigned to either a self-selected goal group (choosing a 10%, 20%, or 30% reduction in daily phone use), an assigned goal group (given a 14% reduction goal, matching the average chosen goal by the self-selected group), or a nogoal control group. Analyses based on over 11,000 daily observations show that, despite identical incentives and comparable average goal difficulty, participants who chose their own goals reduced phone use by 73% more and met their goals 11% more often than those with assigned goals. Greater reductions in phone use and consistent goal achievement were associated with improved well-being: participants in the self-selected condition reported lower depression, anxiety, and perceived addiction at the end of the five-week intervention, with no comparable improvements in the assigned or control conditions. The findings provide causal field evidence on the motivational benefits of autonomy in goal-setting, consistent with Selfdetermination and goal-setting theory.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过随机实地实验发现，在相同激励和平均目标难度下，自主设定目标的参与者比被分配目标的参与者减少手机使用量多73%，达成目标频率高11%，且心理健康状况改善更明显。
AI.research_question: 在平均目标难度和激励相同的情况下，赋予个体目标设定的自主权是否能增强动机和行为改变？
AI.motivation: 行为改变干预通常涉及实验者分配的目标，但自主权在目标设定中的作用尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论和目标设定理论
AI.method: 11周随机实地实验（N=149），参与者分为自主目标组（选择10%、20%或30%手机使用减少）、分配目标组（给定14%减少目标）和无目标对照组。
AI.findings: 自主目标组比分配目标组减少手机使用量多73%，达成目标频率高11%，且抑郁、焦虑和感知成瘾程度显著降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自主权在目标设定中的动机益处提供了因果实地证据，支持自我决定理论和目标设定理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 在行为干预中赋予个体目标设定自主权可以显著提升干预效果和心理健康状况。

detail.title: Empowering African Agriculture through Digital Technologies: Pathways, Evidence, and Policy
detail.abstract: Digital technologies are reshaping agricultural production, value chains, and climate resilience across Africa. This paper synthesizes empirical evidence on how mobile phones, digital extension, precision tools (including remote sensing and drones), and digital platforms influence productivity, market access, and resilience for smallholder farmers. It assesses major barriers-connectivity, affordability, data governance, gender gaps-and highlights scalable policy interventions and public-private partnerships to accelerate equitable adoption. Using a mixed-methods literature synthesis and targeted case studies, the paper finds that digital interventions improve information flows and market linkages, but impact on yields depends on complementary inputs, trustworthy advisory services, and enabling infrastructure. The paper concludes with actionable recommendations for policymakers, donors, and researchers and offers a pragmatic roadmap for scaling digital agriculture across African contexts.

title: Ecological Disaster in the Making: Assessing the Impact of Sino-Metals Leach Tailings Dam Collapse on the Kafue River Ecosystem

detail.title: Ecological Disaster in the Making: Assessing the Impact of Sino-Metals Leach Tailings Dam Collapse on the Kafue River Ecosystem
detail.abstract: The Kafue River ecosystem, a vital component of Zambia's biodiversity and economy, was contaminated by a mine spillage following the collapse of the Sino-Metals Leach Zambia Limited tailings dam on February 18, 2025. This study assessed the effects of the spillage on the Kafue River ecosystem, examining water quality parameters, heavy metal concentrations, and bioaccumulation in fish and pasture samples, compared to a control site and against Zambia Environmental Management Agency (ZEMA) regulatory limits and thresholds from other geographical regions (Australia and New Zealand, and Canada). Water samples from polluted sites showed significant alterations in pH, electrical conductivity, turbidity, and salinity, and elevated levels of copper, iron, zinc, lead, and arsenic, exceeding ZEMA limits and thresholds from Australia-New Zealand and Canada. Sediment analysis revealed substantial contamination, with heavy metal levels exceeding those in the control site. Similar patterns of heavy metal bioaccumulation were observed in both fish and pasture samples, suggesting widespread ecosystem contamination. The findings suggest that the mine spillage had devastating effects, with the combined effects of altered water quality, including severely low pH levels, high heavy metal concentrations, and the resultant bioaccumulation of these metals creating a highly toxic environment that likely contributed to the observed widespread loss of aquatic life. The bioaccumulation and potential biomagnification of heavy metals pose potential health risks to both wildlife and human populations, highlighting the urgent need for effective remediation strategies to mitigate mining pollution impacts and protect the Kafue River ecosystem and its inhabitants. Effective action is necessary to restore the ecosystem and ensure the long-term health and sustainability of this vital resource.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了2025年赞比亚Sino-Metals Leach Zambia Limited尾矿坝溃坝对卡富埃河生态系统的污染影响，发现水质参数显著改变，重金属浓度超标，并在鱼类和牧草中观察到生物累积现象，表明生态系统受到广泛污染，需要紧急修复措施。
AI.research_question: 矿山尾矿坝溃坝对卡富埃河生态系统的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 卡富埃河生态系统是赞比亚生物多样性和经济的重要组成部分，2025年2月18日发生的尾矿坝溃坝事件导致严重污染，需要评估其对生态系统的破坏程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境污染物迁移转化理论、生物累积理论和生态系统风险评估理论。
AI.method: 比较污染地点与对照地点的水质参数、重金属浓度，分析鱼类和牧草样本中的生物累积，并与赞比亚环境管理局标准及其他国家（澳大利亚-新西兰、加拿大）阈值进行对比。
AI.findings: 污染地点水质参数（pH、电导率、浊度、盐度）显著改变，铜、铁、锌、铅、砷等重金属浓度超标，沉积物污染严重，鱼类和牧草中观察到重金属生物累积模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了矿山污染事件对热带河流生态系统影响的实证证据，丰富了环境污染物生物累积和生态风险评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了矿山污染对卡富埃河生态系统的破坏性影响，为制定有效的修复策略提供了科学依据，强调了保护这一重要资源和居民健康的紧迫性。

title: What is the Business Case for Companies Behind Impact Bonds?

detail.title: What is the Business Case for Companies Behind Impact Bonds?
detail.abstract: This thesis explores an emerging application of Impact Bonds (IBs)—referred to as Social Impact Bonds in the UK, Pay-for-Success contracts in the US, and Social Impact Partnerships in Europe—by examining the role of corporations as outcome payers, a function traditionally held by public entities and NGOs. Using a reconstructive qualitative case study of a corporation’s one-time adoption of the IB model, the research investigates internal motivations and external enabling conditions that may support broader corporate engagement. The study introduces the concept of Corporate Impact Bonds (CIBs), demonstrating that IBs can be viable in a private sector context. Successful implementation requires dual interest alignment: internally, between financial and sustainability priorities within the corporation; and externally, between profit-driven partners, supported by conducive market conditions. CIBs show potential to mobilize private capital for sustainable economic transformation, particularly in the circular economy. While the generalisability of the findings is limited, the study provides practical guidance for replication and identifies institutional and psychological drivers as key influences. It concludes that the business case for corporate participation in CIBs lies in intrinsic motivation and a strategic vision for business model transformation, which necessitates new partnerships and supplier ecosystems. These insights warrant further academic inquiry into corporate decision-making processes and enabling conditions, such as data availability from sustainability reporting and the evolving narrative surrounding corporate sustainability efforts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了企业作为结果支付方参与影响力债券（IBs）的新模式，提出了企业影响力债券（CIBs）概念，发现成功实施需要内部财务与可持续发展优先事项的协调，以及外部利润驱动伙伴在市场条件下的协同。
AI.research_question: 企业作为结果支付方参与影响力债券的内部动机和外部促成条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索影响力债券在企业部门的应用潜力，传统上该模式由公共实体和NGO主导结果支付功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业影响力债券（CIBs）概念框架，强调内部和外部利益协调的双重对齐机制。
AI.method: 重构性定性案例研究，分析一家企业一次性采用IB模型的实践。
AI.findings: CIBs在企业部门具有可行性，成功实施需要内部财务与可持续发展优先事项的协调，以及外部利润驱动伙伴在市场条件下的协同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业影响力债券（CIBs）概念，扩展了影响力债券理论在企业部门的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CIBs的复制提供实践指导，识别制度性和心理驱动因素作为关键影响因素，为企业参与循环经济等可持续转型提供路径。

title: Short-run Gain, Long-run Pain? The Inter-Temporal Trade-Off in the Finance-Volatility Relationship
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London

detail.title: Short-run Gain, Long-run Pain? The Inter-Temporal Trade-Off in the Finance-Volatility Relationship
detail.abstract: This paper explores the possibility that financial depth may have a different impact on macroeconomic volatility in the short- versus the long-run. To do so, it employs a panel error-correction model where short- and long-run volatility effects of financial depth are jointly estimated in a sample of 97 countries over the period 1960-2010. Results provide strong evidence that financial depth reduces GDP and investment volatility in the short-run but at the expense of greater volatility in the long-run. Hence there is significant evidence of an inter-temporal tradeoff between financial depth and macroeconomic volatility. Consequently, policymakers must consider both the nature as well as timing of the impact of financial depth on macroeconomic volatility. These findings also reconcile the differing views in related literature on the finance-volatility debate.

AI.tldr: 金融深化在短期和长期对宏观经济波动的影响存在差异：短期降低GDP和投资波动，但长期会增加波动，存在跨期权衡。
AI.research_question: 金融深化在短期和长期对宏观经济波动的影响是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨金融深化对宏观经济波动的影响在时间维度上的复杂性，调和相关文献中的不同观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融深化与宏观经济波动关系的跨期权衡理论
AI.method: 使用面板误差修正模型，在1960-2010年间97个国家的样本中联合估计金融深化的短期和长期波动效应
AI.findings: 金融深化在短期内降低GDP和投资波动，但长期会增加波动，存在显著的跨期权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融深化与宏观经济波动关系的跨期权衡理论，调和了相关文献中的不同观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：必须同时考虑金融深化对宏观经济波动影响的性质和时间维度

title: AI in Courtrooms and the Principle of Natural Justice - Can Machines Ensure Fair Hearings?
affiliations: University of Toronto - Faculty of Law

detail.title: AI in Courtrooms and the Principle of Natural Justice - Can Machines Ensure Fair Hearings?
detail.abstract:
The alacritous incorporation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into judicial systems worldwide has triggered both optimism and unease. From predictive analytics in case management to algorithm-driven decision support tools, AI promises to address appalling delays and inefficiencies that torment modern courts. Yet, this technological emplacement conflicts with one of the oldest and most fundamental doctrines of legal systems i.e., the “Principles of Natural Justice”, particularly the “Right to a Fair Hearing”. The central question that emerges is whether machines, designed to process data and patterns, can protect values rooted in human judgment, transparency, and moral reasoning. While AI may ameliorate access to justice and procedural efficiency, it also raises concerns about algorithmic ambiguity, bias, and the erosion of judicial discretion. This tension between technological efficiency and the constitutional rule of fairness forms the essence of the present inquiry i.e., “Can AI in courtrooms coexist with, and even strengthen, the principle of natural justice, or does it risk undermining the very foundation of fair adjudication?”

This article examines deeply whether AI can beneficially ensure compliance with the principles of natural justice in civil, criminal, and commercial adjudication in India. It also considers how AI might be utilized to perpetuate neutrality, whether decision-making in rural forums like Gram Panchayats or at the Supreme Court level could be delegated to machines, and whether the “humanity” of justice risks being abraded in an AI-driven future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能在司法系统中应用与自然正义原则的冲突，分析AI能否在提高效率的同时保障公平审判权利，以及如何在印度各级法院中平衡技术效率与司法公正。
AI.research_question: AI能否在法庭中与自然正义原则共存并强化之，还是可能破坏公平裁决的基础？
AI.motivation: 全球司法系统快速引入AI技术引发了乐观与担忧的并存，AI承诺解决法院效率低下问题，但与自然正义原则特别是公平听证权产生冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然正义原则、公平听证权、司法公正理论、算法透明度与偏见理论
AI.method: 理论分析与案例研究，考察AI在印度民事、刑事和商业裁决中的应用
AI.findings: AI在提高司法效率和可及性方面具有潜力，但存在算法模糊性、偏见和侵蚀司法裁量权的风险
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了技术效率与司法公正原则之间张力的理论理解，提出了AI与自然正义原则共存的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度各级法院（从乡村法庭到最高法院）的AI应用提供实践指导，帮助平衡技术效率与司法公正

title: Who can we rely on? Banks, Marketplace lenders, or People
affiliations: University of South Carolina - University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business - Department of Economics and University of South Carolina

detail.title: Who can we rely on? Banks, Marketplace lenders, or People
detail.abstract: Credit supply plays a crucial role in the economy, especially during periods of economic and financial crises. As emerging and rapidly growing fintech lenders, marketplace lenders now hold a significant share of the credit supply in the economy. This paper aims to examine marketplace lenders’ credit supply reliability relative to traditional banks amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. Employing the Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework alongside the instrumental variable methodology, our findings reveal that marketplace lenders decrease their credit supply by 0.55% more than large banks and 0.33% more than small banks in the post-COVID period. Furthermore, we explore the fundamental reason behind the greater vulnerability of marketplace lenders’ credit supply compared to banks. Our analysis indicates that the reliance on individual investors makes the funding sources of marketplace lenders less stable relative to those of banks. Additionally, we find a statistically significant indication that individual investors reduce their credit supply by 0.05% and 0.06% compared to passive and active institutional investors, respectively, in response to the COVID-19 crisis. Overall, the findings offer valuable insights for policymakers in designing strategies to strengthen credit supply stability and bolster the resilience of marketplace lenders in times of economic crises.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了疫情期间市场借贷平台与传统银行的信贷供给可靠性，发现市场借贷平台的信贷供给比大型银行减少0.55%，比小型银行减少0.33%。主要原因是市场借贷平台依赖个人投资者，其资金来源不如银行稳定。
AI.research_question: 在COVID-19疫情期间，市场借贷平台的信贷供给可靠性相对于传统银行如何？
AI.motivation: 信贷供给在经济中至关重要，特别是在经济金融危机期间。作为新兴且快速增长的金融科技贷款机构，市场借贷平台现在在经济中占有重要份额。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷供给理论、金融中介理论、投资者行为理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID）框架结合工具变量方法
AI.findings: 市场借贷平台的信贷供给在疫情后比大型银行减少0.55%，比小型银行减少0.33%。个人投资者比被动和主动机构投资者分别减少0.05%和0.06%的信贷供给。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场借贷平台信贷供给脆弱性的根本原因——对个人投资者的依赖导致资金来源不稳定
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计加强信贷供给稳定性和增强市场借贷平台在经济危机时期韧性的策略提供了有价值的见解

title: Real-Time Demand Elasticity During Negative Imbalance Price Events
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Real-Time Demand Elasticity During Negative Imbalance Price Events
detail.abstract: Although negative electricity prices have spread throughout Europe, it is still unclear if they will be able to increase demand in real time. For Austria (2019–2024), we put together a national 15-minute panel that combines APG imbalance settlement prices with matched meteorological, system load, generation mix, and cross-border flows. Timing endogeneity and heterogeneous responses are the focus of a triangulated identification technique that includes quantile treatment effects, propensity-score-matched difference-in-differences, and stacked event study at the commencement of negative-price runs. We discover that, on average, negative imbalance prices raise aggregate load by about 1.9% (≈120 MW at a baseline of 6.3 GW; 95% CI: 0.14–3.65%). Onemonth-out tests limit estimates to a range of 1.8 to 2.1%. Strongly positive in winter and during peak hours, but insignificant or negative in spring/summer and off-peak times, the effects are highly state-contingent. Responses range from +14% to +25% in the top tail, while the median is close to zero, which is consistent with portfolio optimization by industrial/aggregator loads. The causal interpretation is supported by Oster δ (≫ 1), Rosenbaum limits (Γ > 3), and randomization inference (p ≈ 0.0003). The policy is straightforward: under Europe’s ISP-15 architecture, negative imbalance prices function as a targeted flexibility tool that works best when exposure and capability align, but they do not cause widespread changes in demand under the present retail pass-through system. Expanding real-time exposure (optional dynamic tariffs with protections), improving quarter-hour goods, resolving non-energy charge distortions, and facilitating aggregator involvement are all necessary to increase responsiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了奥地利2019-2024年负电价对实时电力需求的影响，发现负不平衡电价平均使总负荷增加约1.9%，但效果具有高度状态依赖性，在冬季和高峰时段显著为正，而在春季/夏季和非高峰时段不显著或为负。
AI.research_question: 负电价是否能够增加实时电力需求？
AI.motivation: 尽管负电价在欧洲广泛出现，但其对实时需求的影响仍不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合优化理论，工业/聚合负荷的优化行为。
AI.method: 三角识别方法，包括分位数处理效应、倾向得分匹配的双重差分法、堆叠事件研究法。
AI.findings: 负不平衡电价平均使总负荷增加约1.9%，效果在冬季和高峰时段显著为正（+14%至+25%），但在春季/夏季和非高峰时段不显著或为负。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了负电价作为针对性灵活性工具的有效性，揭示了负荷响应的异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了扩大实时暴露、改进15分钟商品、解决非能源费用扭曲、促进聚合商参与等政策建议，以提高需求响应能力。

title: CLIMATE CHANGE AND ENERGY PRICE VOLATILITY IN NON-TEMPERATE AND TEMPERATE REGIONS: EVIDENCE FROM PANEL DATA
affiliations: Centre for Econometrics and Applied Research, Centre for Econometrics and Applied Research and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: CLIMATE CHANGE AND ENERGY PRICE VOLATILITY IN NON-TEMPERATE AND TEMPERATE REGIONS: EVIDENCE FROM PANEL DATA
detail.abstract: This study aims to observe the disparity in response between regions of the world focusing on the temperate and non-temperate regions by employing Panel Auto Regressive Distributed Lag Technique to examine how temperature anomaly (ta) and atmospheric carbon dioxide emissions (acdc) affect energy price volatility (epv) across different countries of the world. In this iterative process, we estimate various short and long run dynamics for 39 countries, using dataset spanning from January 1995 to March 2023 due to data availability. Our findings showed that ‘epv’ is greatly impacted by ‘ta’ irrespective of the region in the short and long run. However, there exists an inverse relationship between ‘acdc’ and ‘epv’ significantly for temperate regions than the non-temperate causing a dire need to implement stricter climate change policies for temperate regions which ultimately contributes to a more sustainable future. EPV also serves as a bellwether for economic instability, influencing production costs, consumer spending, and overall economic growth. To address identified challenges, both regions must develop and implement effective energy policies and regulations, promote energy storage solutions and reliable energy supply which will mitigate EPV.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用面板自回归分布滞后技术分析全球39个国家1995-2023年数据，发现温度异常对能源价格波动有显著影响，而大气二氧化碳排放与温带地区能源价格波动呈负相关，建议温带地区实施更严格气候政策。
AI.research_question: 温度异常和大气二氧化碳排放如何影响不同地区（温带与非温带）的能源价格波动？
AI.motivation: 观察全球不同地区对气候变化的响应差异，特别是温带和非温带地区在能源价格波动方面的不同表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 面板自回归分布滞后模型，分析短期和长期动态关系。
AI.method: 使用1995年1月至2023年3月的39个国家数据集，采用面板自回归分布滞后技术进行估计。
AI.findings: 温度异常对能源价格波动有显著影响；大气二氧化碳排放与温带地区能源价格波动呈显著负相关；能源价格波动是经济不稳定的前兆指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候变量与能源价格波动在不同地理区域的差异化影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议温带地区实施更严格气候政策；各地区需制定有效能源政策、推广储能解决方案以确保可靠能源供应。

title: Can public data openness improve total factor productivity of enterprises? -Quasi-natural experiments launched on China's public data platforms
affiliations: Henan Finance University and Beijing Information Science and Technology University

detail.title: Can public data openness improve total factor productivity of enterprises? -Quasi-natural experiments launched on China's public data platforms
detail.abstract: Aim: This paper studied the impact of the policy of launching public data platforms of provincial-level local governments in China on the total factor productivity of enterprises. Methodology: This paper is based on difference-in-difference model and mechanism research model. This paper uses data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2023. Results: This paper has found that public data openness policy improved the total factor productivity of enterprises. This result passed the parallel trend test, placebo test, and other robustness tests.  This result was achieved by improving the company's operational, business, and innovation capabilities. Implications and recommendations: These findings enriched the relevant research on the value creation role of public data elements. Originality: This paper provides a reliable empirical analysis framework for the study of the impact of public data openness on total factor productivity of enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，省级地方政府公共数据开放平台政策能够显著提升企业全要素生产率，这一效应通过改善企业的运营、业务和创新能力实现。
AI.research_question: 省级地方政府公共数据开放平台政策对企业全要素生产率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究公共数据要素在价值创造中的作用，为公共数据开放政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共数据要素价值创造理论，探讨数据开放对企业生产效率的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分模型和机制研究模型，使用2007-2023年中国A股上市公司数据。
AI.findings: 公共数据开放政策显著提高了企业全要素生产率，结果通过了平行趋势检验、安慰剂检验等稳健性检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了公共数据要素价值创造相关研究，为公共数据开放的经济效应提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究公共数据开放对企业全要素生产率影响提供了可靠的实证分析框架，为政策制定提供参考。

title: Can Europe's Decarbonisation Goals Offset the Merit-Order Effect and Support Renewable Energy Value Factors?
affiliations: , Technical University of Denmark and Technical University of Denmark

detail.title: Can Europe's Decarbonisation Goals Offset the Merit-Order Effect and Support Renewable Energy Value Factors?

declarations.funderStatement: This work is funded by the European Union under the Horizon Europe Framework Programme (Project name: SOLARX; grant number: 101084158)

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of variable renewable energy (VRE) in Europe has intensified the merit-order effect and resulted in deteriorating value factors (VF). This raises concerns about the market viability and future investments in VRE technologies. This paper examines how the market value (MV) and VF of VRE technologies may evolve across Europe towards 2050, using the Balmorel energy system model. Three scenarios are analysed, reflecting different levels of sector coupling, each stress-tested against five sub-scenarios that capture uncertainties in technology costs and fuel prices. The results highlight that sector coupling and cross-border interconnections play a decisive role in stabilising VF and mitigating the self-cannibalisation of VRE. Higher flexibility systems reduce average wholesale electricity prices, but improve VF, and vice versa in systems with limited flexibility. Sensitivity analysis indicates that the effect of technology cost uncertainties and fuel price shocks are more pronounced in the near-term. The MV and VF under such sensitivities tend to converge towards the Base case projections by 2050. The findings emphasise the importance of MV, alongside wholesale prices, as a realistic indicator of VRE profitability and investment signals.

AI.tldr: 本文使用Balmorel能源系统模型分析欧洲可变可再生能源(VRE)到2050年的市场价值(MV)和价值因子(VF)演变。研究发现部门耦合和跨境互联对稳定VF、缓解VRE自我蚕食具有决定性作用，灵活性更高的系统能改善VF。技术成本和燃料价格的不确定性在近期影响更显著，但到2050年会趋于收敛。
AI.research_question: 欧洲可变可再生能源(VRE)技术的市场价值(MV)和价值因子(VF)到2050年将如何演变？
AI.motivation: 欧洲VRE的快速扩张加剧了优先顺序效应，导致价值因子恶化，引发了对VRE技术市场可行性和未来投资的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源系统建模理论，特别是Balmorel模型框架，结合市场价值分析、优先顺序效应理论和部门耦合概念。
AI.method: 使用Balmorel能源系统模型，分析三种反映不同部门耦合水平的场景，每个场景针对五个捕捉技术成本和燃料价格不确定性的子场景进行压力测试。
AI.findings: 部门耦合和跨境互联对稳定VF和缓解VRE自我蚕食具有决定性作用；高灵活性系统降低平均批发电价但改善VF；技术成本和燃料价格冲击在近期影响更显著，到2050年趋于收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对VRE市场价值演变机制的理解，强调了部门耦合在稳定VRE价值方面的重要作用，为能源转型经济学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于VRE投资可行性的重要指标，强调市场价值作为投资信号的重要性，为欧洲能源转型战略提供决策支持。

title: Endogenization of Energy Sharing Mechanisms in Energy Communities Demand-Side Scheduling
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Université de Mons - Faculté Polytechnique and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Endogenization of Energy Sharing Mechanisms in Energy Communities Demand-Side Scheduling
detail.abstract: The positive impacts of Energy communities in terms of economics, energy usage and network solicitation from a collective stand-point have widely been demonstrated in the literature. Nevertheless, the settlement of local exchanges and individual bills computation remain major concerns to ensure that the sharing rules are practically implementable and ensure members engagement. Among existing local market mechanisms for settling internal exchanges, the energy sharing and economic surplus sharing paradigms are the most widespread, the former being for instance implemented in Belgium (Wallonia) and France, under the form of distribution keys. In the literature and in real communities, day-ahead optimal dispatch models for the planning of flexible resources within energy communities are required, and always sharing rules-agnostic. Consequently, in this work, we first provide clear insights on the pros and cons between the energy and economic surplus sharing frameworks, by implementing a day-ahead community optimal dispatch model and performing a quantitative comparative study on the same use case made by 8 heterogeneous domestic community members. Then, we show that community members can experience up to 14.76 \% deviation between the expected key-agnostic day-ahead bill and the global community real-time one when the day-ahead dispatch model is key-agnostic and the sharing rules is applied in the settlement period despite assuming a perfect forecast of uncertain quantities. To prevent this deviation, we propose a novel formulation of the optimal dispatch model which endogenizes an energy sharing rule in the scheduling problem chosen out of the six implemented regulatory-compliant energy distribution keys. The proposed approach does not only preserve the day-ahead performances (no deviation between day-ahead and real-time bills), but also reduces the gap from the key-agnostic optimal collective bill to 11.20 \%.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了能源共享和经济盈余共享两种能源社区结算机制，发现传统的关键无关日前调度模型会导致成员账单出现显著偏差（高达14.76%），并提出了一种内生化能源共享规则的新型调度模型，消除了账单偏差并将与最优集体账单的差距降至11.20%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能源社区日前最优调度模型，使其能够考虑共享规则，避免成员预期账单与实际结算账单之间的偏差？
AI.motivation: 能源社区在经济效益、能源使用和网络利用方面具有积极影响，但本地交换结算和个体账单计算是确保共享规则可实施和成员参与度的关键问题。现有调度模型通常与共享规则无关，导致预期与实际账单存在偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源共享与经济盈余共享两种主流本地市场机制框架，以及六种符合监管要求的能源分配密钥。
AI.method: 实施日前社区最优调度模型，在由8个异质家庭组成的社区用例上进行定量比较研究，并提出内生化能源共享规则的新型调度模型。
AI.findings: 关键无关日前调度模型会导致成员账单出现高达14.76%的偏差；提出的内生化模型消除了这种偏差，并将与最优集体账单的差距降至11.20%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将能源共享规则内生化到社区调度模型中，为能源社区调度理论提供了新的建模框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源社区运营商提供了能够准确预测成员账单的调度工具，增强了共享规则的可实施性和成员参与度，具有在比利时（瓦隆尼亚）和法国等已实施能源共享机制地区的应用价值。

title: The Gift of History: The Rural Reconstruction Movement in the Republic of China (1912-1949) and Contemporary Rural-Urban Income Gap
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, South China Agricultural University - National School of Agricultural Institution and Development and South China Agricultural University - College of Economics and Management

detail.title: The Gift of History: The Rural Reconstruction Movement in the Republic of China (1912-1949) and Contemporary Rural-Urban Income Gap
detail.abstract: Contemporary socioeconomic development often exhibits strong path dependence, particularly in regions subject to enduring influences or major disruptions from significant historical events. In China, the Rural Reconstruction Movement during the Republican period (1912–1949) implemented multidimensional reforms in rural areas at that time. However, whether this movement has had a lasting impact on today's urban-rural income gap remains largely unexplored. Using county-level data from 2020 matched with historical records of movement participation, this study examines the mechanisms through which the Rural Reconstruction Movement affected contemporary income disparities. We find that counties that participated in the movement exhibit significantly smaller urban–rural income gaps than non-participating counties. We elucidate the pathways through which this movement operated via four key mechanisms: (1) improved governance, reflected in lower corruption incidence; (2) enhanced human capital, evidenced by higher educational attainment and reduced illiteracy rates; (3) increased economic dynamism, indicated by more newly established enterprises and higher rural incomes; and (4) strengthened public health infrastructure, shown by greater availability of hospital beds. These findings demonstrate that comprehensive historical interventions in governance, education, economic development, and public services can generate persistent benefits for rural development. The policy implication of this study is that after the government addresses the fundamental issue of absolute poverty, adopting multidimensional and multipath approaches may prove more effective in revitalizing rural areas. Furthermore, China's experience may also provide valuable insights for other developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，民国时期参与乡村建设运动的县份，其当代城乡收入差距显著小于未参与县份。该运动通过改善治理、提升人力资本、增强经济活力和完善公共卫生四种机制产生持久影响。

AI.method: 使用2020年县级数据与历史参与记录进行匹配分析

reference: Cardozo Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-26; Cardozo L. Rev. De-Novo (forthcoming)
title: Executive Order 14330: A Solution in Search of a Problem
affiliations: Yeshiva University - Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law

detail.title: Executive Order 14330: A Solution in Search of a Problem

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cardozo Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-26
publicationDetails.journalName: Cardozo Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
President Trump’s executive order 14330 proclaims its determination to “democratiz[e] access to alternative investments for 401(k) investors.” This executive order is a solution in search of a problem. Applicable law already clarifies when a plan fiduciary can and cannot offer alternative investment choices to participants in 401(k) plans.

Many alternative investments, in particular private equity and hedge funds, promise higher returns at the cost of great risk, illiquidity and high fees. Participants in 401(k) plans are typically unsophisticated investors, who have relatively small accounts and who are often close to retirement and the liquidity needs retirement entails. Depending upon the circumstances, an ERISA fiduciary may be able to prudently offer alternative investments to 401(k) participants with appropriate limits to prevent excessive concentration of participants’ retirement accounts in such investments. But, it is imprudent to offer illiquid, risky and high fee investment choices to plan participants when such choices imperil their retirement savings.

Applicable law, including ERISA’s duties of prudence and diversification and carefully-reasoned case law, makes all of this clear. This suggests that the agenda pursued by at least some advocates of executive order 14330 is not the clarification of applicable law. Rather, these proponents seek affirmative modification of this ERISA-based law to actively encourage 401(k) arrangements to offer to plan participants alternative investments, most prominently private equity.

Just as efforts to encourage ESG-investing by ERISA plans deserve skepticism, efforts to “clarify” the ERISA-based fiduciary law governing alternative investments should meet skepticism. Existing law already permits plan fiduciaries to offer alternative investment choices like private equity when it is prudent to do so and requires them to eschew such investments when they are imprudent. Restating this law will not add any substance to ERISA’s fact-intensive legal norms of prudence and diversification.

Insofar as executive order 14330 is intended to weight the scales in favor of particular alternative investment choices such as private equity, that agenda would weaken ERISA’s protections safeguarding participants’ retirement assets. ERISA’s standards of prudence and diversification permit ERISA plan fiduciaries to offer on a case-by-case basis plan participants alternative investments when and if it is appropriate to do so. These standards also require plan fiduciaries to eschew such alternatives when and if is proper to avoid them. These fact-based protective standards should not be attenuated to promote any industry’s products, whether those products are ESG assets or alternative investments.

AI.tldr: 特朗普的行政命令14330声称要"民主化401(k)投资者获取另类投资的渠道"，但该命令是解决方案在寻找问题。现行法律已明确规定了养老金受托人何时可以或不可以向401(k)计划参与者提供另类投资选择。
AI.research_question: 特朗普行政命令14330是否必要？现行ERISA法律是否已经充分规范了401(k)计划中另类投资的使用？
AI.motivation: 分析行政命令14330的合理性，评估其是否真正有助于澄清法律，还是试图削弱ERISA对退休资产保护的现有标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: ERISA的谨慎义务和多元化原则，养老金受托人责任理论，投资者保护理论
AI.method: 法律分析和政策评估，基于现有法律框架和判例法的分析
AI.findings: 现行法律已充分规范了另类投资的使用，行政命令14330是不必要的，且可能削弱对退休参与者的保护
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了ERISA谨慎义务和多元化原则在另类投资监管中的适用性，强调了事实基础保护标准的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于行政命令14330潜在风险的警示，强调了不应为了特定行业利益而削弱投资者保护标准

title: Financial Inclusion and Regional Disparities in India: Insights from FI Index & PMJDY `
affiliations: BabaSaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University

detail.title: Financial Inclusion and Regional Disparities in India: Insights from FI Index & PMJDY `
detail.abstract: This paper presents an analysis of financial inclusion across India's 36 states through the construction of a multidimensional Index for Financial Inclusion (IFI). The IFI incorporates three key dimensions penetration, availability, and usage of banking services providing a comprehensive measure of inclusiveness. Financial inclusion enables equitable economic development by providing accessible, affordable financial products such as savings, credit, insurance, and remittances. These services foster asset accumulation, risk management, and economic opportunity, contributing to poverty alleviation and Sustainable Development Goals. Inclusion also empowers marginalized groups, notably women and rural residents, enhancing financial literacy and decision-making power. India's financial inclusion journey, marked by bank nationalization, rural credit enhancement, and recent digital initiatives like PMJDY and UPI, reflects its evolving landscape. The PMJDY program has significantly expanded account ownership and digital services, though challenges in rural and underserved areas remain. This study offers vital insights for policymakers aiming to deepen financial inclusion and empower marginalized communities in India. Despite policy efforts, a significant portion of India's population remains excluded from formal financial systems, calling for prioritization of financial inclusion in national growth strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建多维金融包容性指数（IFI）分析了印度36个邦的金融包容性状况，该指数包含银行服务的渗透率、可获得性和使用率三个关键维度，为政策制定者提供了深化金融包容性和赋权边缘化社区的重要见解。
AI.research_question: 如何全面衡量印度各邦的金融包容性水平？
AI.motivation: 尽管有政策努力，印度仍有大量人口被排除在正规金融体系之外，需要在国家增长战略中优先考虑金融包容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论，包括金融服务的可及性、可负担性和使用情况对经济发展的影响。
AI.method: 构建多维金融包容性指数（IFI），包含渗透率、可获得性和使用率三个维度，对印度36个邦进行分析。
AI.findings: PMJDY计划显著扩大了账户所有权和数字服务，但农村和服务不足地区仍面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的金融包容性测量框架，丰富了金融包容性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了深化金融包容性和赋权边缘化社区的具体建议，有助于实现可持续发展目标。

title: The Dynamic Impact of Refugee Immigration on Native Workers

detail.title: The Dynamic Impact of Refugee Immigration on Native Workers

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-058
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how low and medium-skilled refugee immigration affects natives' labor market outcomes. Using individual-level panel data on the German workforce for 2011-2019 and exogenous regional variation from processing authorities' distances, we find that a larger inflow of refugees to a district increases the probability of full-time employment for incumbent workers. Fewer outflows of employment drive this effect. The yearly estimates suggest positive labor demand responses in the short run-in occupations that supply services to the refugees-and positive labor supply effects in the medium run-in manufacturing occupations. Wages, job task composition, and job changes remain unaffected, though positive mobility responses are observed.

AI.tldr: 研究德国2011-2019年低中技能难民移民对本地人劳动力市场的影响，发现难民流入增加本地工人全职就业概率，主要通过减少就业流出实现。短期在服务难民的相关职业有正劳动需求效应，中期在制造业有正劳动供给效应。
AI.research_question: 低中技能难民移民如何影响本地人的劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 理解难民移民对接收国劳动力市场的实际影响，为相关政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场供需理论，分析难民移民对本地就业和工资的影响机制。

AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了难民移民对本地劳动力市场影响的理论机制，区分了短期需求效应和中期供给效应。
